pairs.spanish: El ministro rechazó rotundamente la acusación.
pairs.english: The minister flatly rejected the accusation.

pairs.spanish: Primordial resultó el acuerdo firmado entre ambos países.
pairs.english: The agreement signed between both countries turned out to be paramount.

pairs.spanish: Bajo esa premisa trabajaron los investigadores durante años.
pairs.english: Under that premise the researchers worked for years.

pairs.spanish: De enorme relevancia son los hallazgos recientes.
pairs.english: Of immense relevance are the recent findings.

pairs.spanish: Insólito resultó el giro político en aquella región.
pairs.english: Unusual was the political turn in that region.

pairs.spanish: En aquella ciudad comenzó la rebelión.
pairs.english: In that city the rebellion began.

pairs.spanish: No fue la suerte, sino la constancia lo que aseguró el éxito.
pairs.english: It was not luck but perseverance that ensured success.

pairs.spanish: No fue Ana quien llamó, sino su hermano.
pairs.english: It was not Ana who called, but her brother.

pairs.spanish: No es un fracaso, sino más bien una lección.
pairs.english: It is not a failure, but rather a lesson.

pairs.spanish: No rechazaron la propuesta, sino que pidieron más detalles.
pairs.english: They did not reject the proposal; they asked for more details.

pairs.spanish: Fue en 1941 cuando apareció el cuento por primera vez.
pairs.english: It was in 1941 that the story first appeared.

pairs.spanish: De esa imagen viene el título del cuento.
pairs.english: From that image comes the title of the story.

pairs.spanish: Lo que hace único este cuento no es la intriga, sino la idea del tiempo.
pairs.english: What makes this story unique is not the plot but the idea of time.

pairs.spanish: Llovía cuando salimos de la estación.
pairs.english: It was raining when we left the station.

pairs.spanish: Era de noche y hacía frío cuando llegó el tren.
pairs.english: It was night and it was cold when the train arrived.

pairs.spanish: Mientras todos dormían, ella escribió una carta.
pairs.english: While everyone was asleep, she wrote a letter.

pairs.spanish: Estaba cansada, pero abrió la puerta y entró.
pairs.english: She was tired, but she opened the door and went in.

pairs.spanish: Cuando llegó la ayuda, el fuego ya se había apagado.
pairs.english: When help arrived, the fire had already gone out.

pairs.spanish: Mi abuelo me había contado esa historia años antes, pero solo la recordé aquella noche.
pairs.english: My grandfather had told me that story years before, but I only remembered it that night.

pairs.spanish: Estaba nervioso porque nunca había hablado en público.
pairs.english: He was nervous because he had never spoken in public.

pairs.spanish: Conocí a Lucía en una fiesta; antes no sabía ni su nombre.
pairs.english: I met Lucía at a party; before that I did not even know her name.

pairs.spanish: Supimos que había ganado cuando nos llamó su madre.
pairs.english: We found out he had won when his mother called us.

pairs.spanish: La jefa no quiso firmar el contrato.
pairs.english: The boss refused to sign the contract.

pairs.spanish: Teníamos poco tiempo, pero pudimos llegar a tiempo.
pairs.english: We had little time, but we managed to arrive in time.

pairs.spanish: Apenas salí de casa, empezó a llover.
pairs.english: As soon as I left the house, it started to rain.

pairs.spanish: Al cabo de unos minutos, el niño dejó de llorar.
pairs.english: After a few minutes, the child stopped crying.

pairs.spanish: A medida que caía la noche, las calles se quedaban vacías.
pairs.english: As night fell, the streets emptied.

pairs.spanish: En cuanto llegamos al hotel, nos dormimos.
pairs.english: As soon as we got to the hotel, we fell asleep.

pairs.spanish: Buenas tardes, quería pedirle una cita con el doctor.
pairs.english: Good afternoon, I would like to ask you for an appointment with the doctor.

pairs.spanish: Disculpe, venía a preguntar por el horario de los trenes.
pairs.english: Excuse me, I have come to ask about the train timetable.

pairs.spanish: Hola, Marta, llamaba para preguntarte si puedes venir mañana.
pairs.english: Hi, Marta, I'm calling to ask if you can come tomorrow.

pairs.spanish: Me preguntaba si usted podría ayudarme con esto.
pairs.english: I was wondering if you could help me with this.

pairs.spanish: A lo mejor Marta se quedó dormida.
pairs.english: Maybe Marta fell asleep.

pairs.spanish: Tal vez tiene razón.
pairs.english: Perhaps she is right.

pairs.spanish: Tal vez tenga razón, pero no estoy seguro.
pairs.english: Perhaps she is right, but I am not sure.

pairs.spanish: Puede que llueva esta tarde.
pairs.english: It may rain this afternoon.

pairs.spanish: Está en la oficina, tal vez.
pairs.english: He is in the office, perhaps.

pairs.spanish: Es evidente que Marta sabe la verdad.
pairs.english: It is clear that Marta knows the truth.

pairs.spanish: Es probable que Marta sepa la verdad.
pairs.english: It is probable that Marta knows the truth.

pairs.spanish: No es seguro que Marta sepa la verdad.
pairs.english: It is not certain that Marta knows the truth.

pairs.spanish: No hay duda de que Marta sabe la verdad.
pairs.english: There is no doubt that Marta knows the truth.

pairs.spanish: Es poco probable que hayan salido tan temprano.
pairs.english: It is unlikely that they left so early.

pairs.spanish: Marta no contesta; estará durmiendo.
pairs.english: Marta is not answering; she is probably sleeping.

pairs.spanish: Tendrá unos cuarenta años, a juzgar por su aspecto.
pairs.english: She is probably about forty, judging by her appearance.

pairs.spanish: Ya habrán llegado a casa.
pairs.english: They have probably got home by now.

pairs.spanish: ¿Dónde habré dejado las llaves?
pairs.english: Where can I have left my keys?

pairs.spanish: Serán las nueve y media.
pairs.english: It is probably half past nine.

pairs.spanish: Cuando salí de casa, serían las nueve.
pairs.english: When I left home it was probably about nine.

pairs.spanish: El vecino tendría unos sesenta años.
pairs.english: The neighbour was probably about sixty.

pairs.spanish: Nadie contestó; estarían todos dormidos.
pairs.english: Nobody answered; they were probably all asleep.

pairs.spanish: ¿Por qué nadie lo impediría?
pairs.english: Why did nobody stop it, I wonder?

pairs.spanish: ¿Quién llamaría a esa hora?
pairs.english: Who can have been calling at that hour?

pairs.spanish: Seguramente Marta ya salió de la oficina.
pairs.english: Marta has most likely left the office already.

pairs.spanish: Sin duda, es la mejor opción.
pairs.english: Without doubt, it is the best option.

pairs.spanish: Posiblemente tiene razón, pero no estoy seguro.
pairs.english: She is possibly right, but I am not sure.

pairs.spanish: Por lo visto, Pablo cambió de trabajo.
pairs.english: Apparently, Pablo has changed jobs.

pairs.spanish: Marta ya salió, seguramente.
pairs.english: Marta has already left, most likely.

pairs.spanish: El director prohibió que usáramos el celular durante la reunión.
pairs.english: The director forbade us to use our phones during the meeting.

pairs.spanish: Mis padres no permitían que volviéramos tarde a casa.
pairs.english: My parents did not allow us to come home late.

pairs.spanish: El mal tiempo impidió que el avión saliera a la hora.
pairs.english: The bad weather stopped the plane from leaving on time.

pairs.spanish: Los vecinos insistieron en que cenáramos con ellos.
pairs.english: The neighbours insisted that we have dinner with them.

pairs.spanish: Es injusto que hayan cambiado el horario sin avisar.
pairs.english: It is unfair that they have changed the schedule without warning.

pairs.spanish: Era lógico que los clientes quisieran una respuesta rápida.
pairs.english: It was logical that the customers wanted a quick answer.

pairs.spanish: Es ridículo que tengamos que esperar tanto.
pairs.english: It is ridiculous that we have to wait so long.

pairs.spanish: Es razonable que pidan más tiempo para el proyecto.
pairs.english: It is reasonable that they ask for more time for the project.

pairs.spanish: Me alegra que por fin tengas un trabajo nuevo.
pairs.english: I'm glad that you finally have a new job.

pairs.spanish: Lamento que no puedan venir a la cena.
pairs.english: I'm sorry that you cannot come to the dinner.

pairs.spanish: Me sorprende que Carmen no haya llegado todavía.
pairs.english: It surprises me that Carmen hasn't arrived yet.

pairs.spanish: Nos alegra que hayan encontrado una solución.
pairs.english: We are glad that they have found a solution.

pairs.spanish: Mi jefa espera terminar hoy.
pairs.english: My boss hopes to finish today.

pairs.spanish: Mi jefa espera que terminemos hoy.
pairs.english: My boss hopes that we finish today.

pairs.spanish: Ana se negó a firmar el contrato sin leerlo.
pairs.english: Ana refused to sign the contract without reading it.

pairs.spanish: Mi hermano pretende que le prestemos el carro.
pairs.english: My brother expects us to lend him the car.

pairs.spanish: Se recomienda que los visitantes lean el aviso antes de entrar.
pairs.english: Visitors are recommended to read the notice before entering.

pairs.spanish: Se sugiere que cada persona traiga su propia botella de agua.
pairs.english: Each person is advised to bring their own bottle of water.

pairs.spanish: Sería conveniente que usted hablara con la jefa hoy.
pairs.english: It would be advisable for you to speak to the boss today.

pairs.spanish: Convendría que revisáramos la sugerencia antes de la reunión.
pairs.english: It would be a good idea for us to check the suggestion before the meeting.

pairs.spanish: Pienso que la idea es buena.
pairs.english: I think the idea is good.

pairs.spanish: No pienso que la idea sea buena.
pairs.english: I don't think the idea is good.

pairs.spanish: Creo que no es una buena idea.
pairs.english: I think it is not a good idea.

pairs.spanish: No me parece que tenga razón.
pairs.english: It doesn't seem to me that he is right.

pairs.spanish: No creía que fuera verdad.
pairs.english: I didn't think it was true.

pairs.spanish: Dudo que Marta lo sepa.
pairs.english: I doubt that Marta knows it.

pairs.spanish: No dudo que Marta lo sabe.
pairs.english: I do not doubt that Marta knows it.

pairs.spanish: El jefe negó que fuera su error.
pairs.english: The boss denied that it was his mistake.

pairs.spanish: Pablo desmintió que fuera cierto.
pairs.english: Pablo denied that it was true.

pairs.spanish: Pongo en duda que sea una buena idea.
pairs.english: I question whether it is a good idea.

pairs.spanish: No es que no quiera ir, sino que no puedo.
pairs.english: It is not that I do not want to go, but that I cannot.

pairs.spanish: No es que Marta esté enojada, sino que está cansada.
pairs.english: It is not that Marta is angry, it is that she is tired.

pairs.spanish: No es que no me guste el trabajo, sino que gano poco.
pairs.english: It is not that I dislike the job, but that I earn little.

pairs.spanish: No era que Pablo no quisiera ayudar, sino que no sabía cómo.
pairs.english: It was not that Pablo did not want to help, but that he did not know how.

pairs.spanish: No es que tenga miedo, sino que prefiero esperar.
pairs.english: It is not that I am afraid, it is that I prefer to wait.

pairs.spanish: Puede ser que Marta tenga razón.
pairs.english: Marta may be right.

pairs.spanish: ¿Acaso crees que es tan fácil?
pairs.english: Do you really think it is that easy?

pairs.spanish: Puede que sí, puede que no.
pairs.english: Maybe yes, maybe not.

pairs.spanish: Quizás tengas razón, pero no creo que sea tan simple.
pairs.english: Perhaps you are right, but I do not think it is that simple.

pairs.spanish: Es posible que se haya equivocado, pero no creo que lo haga otra vez.
pairs.english: It is possible that he made a mistake, but I do not think he will do it again.

pairs.spanish: Puede que tengas razón, pero no creo que sea tan sencillo.
pairs.english: You may be right, but I do not think it is that simple.

pairs.spanish: Yo no diría que sea un error, pero dudo que sea la mejor opción.
pairs.english: I wouldn't say it is a mistake, but I doubt it is the best option.

pairs.spanish: No es que esté en contra de la idea, sino que me faltan datos.
pairs.english: It is not that I am against the idea, it is that I lack data.

pairs.spanish: Entiendo tu punto de vista, pero no estoy de acuerdo.
pairs.english: I understand your point of view, but I do not agree.

pairs.spanish: Me molesta que mis vecinos hagan ruido por la noche.
pairs.english: It bothers me that my neighbours make noise at night.

pairs.spanish: Nos preocupa que el precio siga subiendo.
pairs.english: It worries us that the price keeps going up.

pairs.spanish: Les encanta que los visitantes se queden a cenar.
pairs.english: They love it that the visitors stay for dinner.

pairs.spanish: Me fastidió que nadie avisara.
pairs.english: It annoyed me that nobody warned us.

pairs.spanish: Siento que tengas que trabajar este fin de semana.
pairs.english: I'm sorry that you have to work this weekend.

pairs.spanish: Lamentamos que no hayan podido venir.
pairs.english: We are sorry that they have not been able to come.

pairs.spanish: Temo que la reunión termine muy tarde.
pairs.english: I'm afraid that the meeting will finish very late.

pairs.spanish: Temíamos que el tren llegara tarde.
pairs.english: We were afraid that the train would arrive late.

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué pena que no puedas venir!
pairs.english: What a shame that you can't come!

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué bueno que te guste el regalo!
pairs.english: How good that you like the present!

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué bien que hayan llegado a tiempo!
pairs.english: How good that they have arrived on time!

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué barbaridad que cerraran el cine del barrio!
pairs.english: How outrageous that they closed the neighbourhood cinema!

pairs.spanish: El hecho de que el tren llegue con retraso me molesta.
pairs.english: The fact that the train arrives late bothers me.

pairs.spanish: El hecho de que ella llegue tarde no la disculpa.
pairs.english: The fact that she arrives late does not excuse her.

pairs.spanish: El hecho de que hayan ganado no significa que tengan razón.
pairs.english: The fact that they have won does not mean that they are right.

pairs.spanish: El hecho de que lloviera no cambió nuestros planes.
pairs.english: The fact that it rained did not change our plans.

pairs.spanish: Me preocupa que la contaminación afecte la salud de los niños.
pairs.english: It worries me that pollution affects children's health.

pairs.spanish: Es una pena que muchos jóvenes no encuentren trabajo.
pairs.english: It's a pity that many young people can't find work.

pairs.spanish: Nos molesta que los precios suban cada mes.
pairs.english: It bothers us that prices go up every month.

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué injusto que unos tengan tanto y otros tan poco!
pairs.english: How unfair that some have so much and others so little!

pairs.spanish: Tan pronto como termine la reunión, te llamo.
pairs.english: As soon as the meeting ends, I'll call you.

pairs.spanish: En cuanto lleguemos al hotel, vamos a cenar.
pairs.english: As soon as we get to the hotel, we're going to have dinner.

pairs.spanish: Apenas tenga los resultados, te los mando.
pairs.english: As soon as I have the results, I'll send them to you.

pairs.spanish: Llámame en cuanto llegues.
pairs.english: Call me as soon as you arrive.

pairs.spanish: Espero aquí hasta que me llamen.
pairs.english: I'll wait here until they call me.

pairs.spanish: No salgo de la oficina hasta que termine este informe.
pairs.english: I'm not leaving the office until I finish this report.

pairs.spanish: No te muevas hasta que yo te diga.
pairs.english: Don't move until I tell you.

pairs.spanish: No me voy hasta que no me paguen.
pairs.english: I'm not leaving until they pay me. (The second no adds nothing.)

pairs.spanish: Mientras dure la tormenta, nos quedamos en el café.
pairs.english: As long as the storm lasts, we'll stay in the café.

pairs.spanish: Te presto mi carro mientras lo cuides.
pairs.english: I'll lend you my car as long as you look after it.

pairs.spanish: Mientras tenga trabajo, no pienso mudarme.
pairs.english: As long as I have work, I don't plan to move.

pairs.spanish: Mientras esperábamos el autobús, empezó a llover.
pairs.english: While we were waiting for the bus, it started to rain.

pairs.spanish: Siempre que hay tormenta, se va la luz.
pairs.english: Whenever there is a storm, the power goes out.

pairs.spanish: Siempre que visitaba a mi abuela, me preparaba chocolate caliente.
pairs.english: Whenever I visited my grandmother, she made me hot chocolate.

pairs.spanish: Te presto el carro siempre que me avises antes.
pairs.english: I'll lend you the car provided you tell me beforehand.

pairs.spanish: Cada vez que necesites ayuda, llámame.
pairs.english: Every time you need help, call me.

pairs.spanish: Cierra la ventana antes de que empiece a llover.
pairs.english: Close the window before it starts to rain.

pairs.spanish: Llegamos a la estación antes de que saliera el tren.
pairs.english: We got to the station before the train left.

pairs.spanish: Hablamos después de que termine la reunión.
pairs.english: We'll talk after the meeting ends.

pairs.spanish: Después de que terminó la reunión, todos se fueron.
pairs.english: After the meeting ended, everyone left.

pairs.spanish: Aunque tiene noventa años, todavía viaja solo.
pairs.english: Although he is ninety, he still travels alone.

pairs.spanish: Aunque cueste mucho dinero, voy a comprarlo.
pairs.english: Even if it costs a lot of money, I'm going to buy it.

pairs.spanish: Aunque llueva mañana, vamos al campo.
pairs.english: Even if it rains tomorrow, we're going to the country.

pairs.spanish: No voy a cambiar de idea aunque tengas razón.
pairs.english: I'm not going to change my mind even if you are right.

pairs.spanish: Si bien el proyecto es caro, ofrece muchas ventajas.
pairs.english: Although the project is expensive, it offers many advantages.

pairs.spanish: Si bien llegamos tarde, pudimos ver el final del concierto.
pairs.english: Although we arrived late, we were able to see the end of the concert.

pairs.spanish: Esta ciudad, si bien es pequeña, tiene mucha vida cultural.
pairs.english: This city, although it is small, has a lot of cultural life.

pairs.spanish: Si bien tiene poca experiencia, trabaja con mucho empeño.
pairs.english: Although he has little experience, he works with great determination.

pairs.spanish: Por más que estudies, necesitas descansar.
pairs.english: No matter how much you study, you need to rest.

pairs.spanish: Por mucho que cueste, vamos a terminar el proyecto.
pairs.english: However much it costs, we're going to finish the project.

pairs.spanish: Por muy cansado que esté, siempre ayuda a su madre.
pairs.english: However tired he is, he always helps his mother.

pairs.spanish: Por más que lo intentó, no pudo abrir la puerta.
pairs.english: However hard he tried, he couldn't open the door.

pairs.spanish: Aun cuando sea difícil, vamos a decir la verdad.
pairs.english: Even if it is difficult, we are going to tell the truth.

pairs.spanish: Vamos a seguir adelante aun cuando haya problemas.
pairs.english: We are going to carry on even if there are problems.

pairs.spanish: Aun cuando tenía miedo, habló delante de todos.
pairs.english: Even though he was afraid, he spoke in front of everyone.

pairs.spanish: El museo abrirá aun cuando llueva.
pairs.english: The museum will open even if it rains.

pairs.spanish: Pase lo que pase, te voy a apoyar.
pairs.english: Whatever happens, I'm going to support you.

pairs.spanish: Diga lo que diga, no voy a cambiar de opinión.
pairs.english: Whatever he says, I'm not going to change my mind.

pairs.spanish: Voy a terminar este trabajo sea como sea.
pairs.english: I'm going to finish this work one way or another.

pairs.spanish: Estés donde estés, llámame el domingo.
pairs.english: Wherever you are, call me on Sunday.

pairs.spanish: Si el gobierno ofreciera ayuda, muchas familias podrían comprar su casa.
pairs.english: If the government offered help, many families could buy their home.

pairs.spanish: Si mañana nevara en la ciudad, cerrarían las escuelas.
pairs.english: If it snowed in the city tomorrow, they would close the schools.

pairs.spanish: Viviríamos en el campo si pudiéramos elegir.
pairs.english: We would live in the countryside if we could choose.

pairs.spanish: Si pudiera elegir, quisiera vivir cerca del mar.
pairs.english: If I could choose, I would like to live near the sea.

pairs.spanish: —¿Vendrá Marta a la fiesta? —Pudiera ser.
pairs.english: "Will Marta come to the party?" "She might."

pairs.spanish: Ana trabaja demasiado y debiera descansar un poco.
pairs.english: Ana works too much and should rest a little.

pairs.spanish: Quisiéramos reservar una mesa para cuatro personas.
pairs.english: We would like to book a table for four.

pairs.spanish: Si fuera tan amable de esperar un momento, el director lo recibirá enseguida.
pairs.english: If you would be so kind as to wait a moment, the director will see you right away.

pairs.spanish: Si tuviera un momento, me gustaría hacerle una pregunta.
pairs.english: If you had a moment, I would like to ask you a question.

pairs.spanish: Le agradecería que me enviara el contrato antes del viernes.
pairs.english: I would be grateful if you sent me the contract before Friday.

pairs.spanish: Sería mejor que lo habláramos mañana.
pairs.english: It would be better if we talked about it tomorrow.

pairs.spanish: Firmaremos el contrato siempre que nos den más tiempo.
pairs.english: We will sign the contract provided that they give us more time.

pairs.spanish: Acepto el trabajo con tal de que me dejen trabajar desde casa.
pairs.english: I accept the job as long as they let me work from home.

pairs.spanish: El banco dará el crédito a condición de que presentemos todos los documentos.
pairs.english: The bank will give the loan on condition that we present all the documents.

pairs.spanish: Iría a cualquier parte con tal de viajar con ustedes.
pairs.english: I would go anywhere as long as I travel with you.

pairs.spanish: Dijeron que firmarían siempre que les diéramos más tiempo.
pairs.english: They said they would sign provided that we gave them more time.

pairs.spanish: Iremos al parque a menos que llueva.
pairs.english: We will go to the park unless it rains.

pairs.spanish: No saldremos a no ser que mejore el tiempo.
pairs.english: We will not go out unless the weather improves.

pairs.spanish: Nadie puede entrar al archivo salvo que tenga permiso.
pairs.english: No one can enter the archive unless they have permission.

pairs.spanish: Dijo que vendría a menos que tuviera trabajo.
pairs.english: She said she would come unless she had work.

pairs.spanish: Salgo temprano, salvo si hay mucho trabajo.
pairs.english: I leave early, except if there is a lot of work.

pairs.spanish: Si hubiéramos salido más temprano, habríamos llegado antes del concierto.
pairs.english: If we had left earlier, we would have arrived before the concert.

pairs.spanish: El proyecto habría terminado a tiempo si el equipo hubiera tenido más ayuda.
pairs.english: The project would have finished on time if the team had had more help.

pairs.spanish: Si no hubiera sido por el mapa, nos habríamos perdido en la montaña.
pairs.english: If it had not been for the map, we would have got lost in the mountains.

pairs.spanish: Si me hubieras avisado, te hubiera acompañado al médico.
pairs.english: If you had told me, I would have gone with you to the doctor.

pairs.spanish: Si hubiéramos tenido más tiempo, hubiéramos visitado el museo.
pairs.english: If we had had more time, we would have visited the museum.

pairs.spanish: Si hubieras estudiado más, habrías aprobado.
pairs.english: If you had studied more, you would have passed.

pairs.spanish: Debería haber salido más temprano; ahora llegamos tarde.
pairs.english: I should have left earlier; now we are late.

pairs.spanish: Deberías haber avisado antes de cambiar la hora.
pairs.english: You should have warned us before changing the time.

pairs.spanish: Tendríamos que haber reservado la mesa con tiempo.
pairs.english: We should have booked the table in advance.

pairs.spanish: Me arrepiento de haber dicho eso.
pairs.english: I regret having said that.

pairs.spanish: De ser necesario, te llamo mañana.
pairs.english: If necessary, I will call you tomorrow.

pairs.spanish: De haber previsto el problema, habríamos cambiado el plan.
pairs.english: Had we foreseen the problem, we would have changed the plan.

pairs.spanish: Hablando con calma, todos se entenderían mejor.
pairs.english: If everyone spoke calmly, they would understand each other better.

pairs.spanish: Hubiera sabido la verdad, habría actuado de otra manera.
pairs.english: Had I known the truth, I would have acted differently.

pairs.spanish: Hubiéramos salido antes, habríamos llegado a tiempo.
pairs.english: Had we left earlier, we would have arrived on time.

pairs.spanish: Aun cuando hubiéramos salido antes, no habríamos llegado a tiempo.
pairs.english: Even if we had left earlier, we would not have arrived on time.

pairs.spanish: Si hubiera aceptado aquel empleo, ahora viviría en Lima.
pairs.english: If I had accepted that job, I would live in Lima now.

pairs.spanish: Si no nos hubiéramos conocido en la universidad, hoy no estaríamos juntos.
pairs.english: If we had not met at university, we would not be together today.

pairs.spanish: Si mis padres no hubieran viajado a Chile, yo no hablaría español.
pairs.english: If my parents had not travelled to Chile, I would not speak Spanish.

pairs.spanish: Si hubieras llamado ayer, ahora sabrías la respuesta.
pairs.english: If you had called yesterday, you would know the answer now.

pairs.spanish: Si mi hermano no fuera tan terco, habría pedido perdón.
pairs.english: If my brother were not so stubborn, he would have said sorry.

pairs.spanish: Si no tuviéramos miedo a volar, habríamos ido en avión.
pairs.english: If we were not afraid of flying, we would have gone by plane.

pairs.spanish: Si Marta fuera más ordenada, no habría perdido las llaves.
pairs.english: If Marta were tidier, she would not have lost the keys.

pairs.spanish: Si mi hermana viviera cerca, la habríamos visitado más.
pairs.english: If my sister lived nearby, we would have visited her more.

pairs.spanish: Te presto el carro siempre y cuando lo devuelvas antes de las seis.
pairs.english: I will lend you the car as long as you bring it back before six.

pairs.spanish: El dueño devolverá la fianza siempre y cuando dejemos el apartamento limpio.
pairs.english: The owner will return the deposit as long as we leave the flat clean.

pairs.spanish: Firmaremos el contrato con la condición de que nos den más tiempo.
pairs.english: We will sign the contract on the condition that they give us more time.

pairs.spanish: Dijeron que aceptarían siempre y cuando bajáramos el precio.
pairs.english: They said they would accept as long as we lowered the price.

pairs.spanish: El museo abre todos los días, excepto si hay una fiesta.
pairs.english: The museum opens every day, except if there is a festival.

pairs.spanish: Nadie entra a la sala excepto que tenga permiso.
pairs.english: No one enters the room unless they have permission.

pairs.spanish: No cambiaremos la fecha a menos que haya un imprevisto.
pairs.english: We will not change the date unless something unexpected happens.

pairs.spanish: Dijo que vendría a no ser que tuviera trabajo.
pairs.english: She said she would come unless she had work.

pairs.spanish: Usted, si no me equivoco, ya trabajó con nosotros.
pairs.english: You, if I am not mistaken, have already worked with us.

pairs.spanish: Si me permite, quisiera hacer una breve objeción.
pairs.english: If you will allow me, I would like to make a short objection.

pairs.spanish: Si no es molestia, ¿podría repetir la dirección?
pairs.english: If it is no trouble, could you repeat the address?

pairs.spanish: El plazo termina el viernes, si mal no recuerdo.
pairs.english: The deadline ends on Friday, if I remember rightly.

pairs.spanish: La escuela organizó una reunión a fin de que los padres conocieran al director.
pairs.english: The school organised a meeting so that the parents could meet the head.

pairs.spanish: Cambiaremos el horario con el objeto de que todos puedan venir.
pairs.english: We will change the schedule so that everyone can come.

pairs.spanish: Te envío el plano a fin de que encuentres la casa sin problemas.
pairs.english: I am sending you the map so that you can find the house without problems.

pairs.spanish: Hablé con el jefe con el objeto de que nos diera más tiempo.
pairs.english: I spoke to the boss so that he would give us more time.

pairs.spanish: El alcalde viajó a la capital con el objeto de reunirse con la ministra.
pairs.english: The mayor travelled to the capital in order to meet the minister.

pairs.spanish: Reservamos con tiempo a fin de conseguir buenos precios.
pairs.english: We booked in advance in order to get good prices.

pairs.spanish: Hizo varias gestiones a fin de obtener el permiso.
pairs.english: She took several steps in order to get the permit.

pairs.spanish: Aprendí inglés para trabajar en el extranjero.
pairs.english: I learned English in order to work abroad.

pairs.spanish: Ahorramos dinero con miras a comprar una casa.
pairs.english: We save money with a view to buying a house.

pairs.spanish: El club reservó el hotel con vistas a las vacaciones de julio.
pairs.english: The club booked the hotel with the July holidays in mind.

pairs.spanish: Abrieron una oficina nueva con miras al mercado regional.
pairs.english: They opened a new office with the regional market in mind.

pairs.spanish: Cambiamos el horario de modo que todos pudieran venir.
pairs.english: We changed the schedule so that everyone could come.

pairs.spanish: Cierra la puerta para que el gato no salga a la calle.
pairs.english: Close the door so that the cat does not go out into the street.

pairs.spanish: Anotamos la hora a fin de no llegar tarde.
pairs.english: We wrote down the time so as not to arrive late.

pairs.spanish: Anota el número, no sea que lo olvides.
pairs.english: Write the number down, in case you forget it.

pairs.spanish: Cerramos las ventanas a fin de que no entrara el frío.
pairs.english: We closed the windows so that the cold would not come in.

pairs.spanish: Si tuviera más dinero, compraría libros para que los niños leyeran más.
pairs.english: If I had more money, I would buy books so that the children would read more.

pairs.spanish: Si pudiera, hablaría con ella para que no se sintiera sola.
pairs.english: If I could, I would talk to her so that she would not feel alone.

pairs.spanish: Si hubiera tenido tiempo, habría llamado para que supieran que estaba bien.
pairs.english: If I had had time, I would have called so that they would know I was fine.

pairs.spanish: Si fuera director, cambiaría el horario a fin de que todos pudieran descansar.
pairs.english: If I were the director, I would change the schedule so that everyone could rest.

pairs.spanish: Busco a alguien que me ayude.
pairs.english: I'm looking for someone to help me.

pairs.spanish: Encontré a alguien que me ayuda.
pairs.english: I found someone who helps me.

pairs.spanish: No hay nadie que sepa la respuesta.
pairs.english: There is nobody who knows the answer.

pairs.spanish: No tengo ningún libro que explique eso.
pairs.english: I don't have any book that explains that.

pairs.spanish: ¿Conoces a alguien que sepa cocinar?
pairs.english: Do you know anyone who can cook?

pairs.spanish: Sí, conozco a alguien que sabe cocinar muy bien.
pairs.english: Yes, I know someone who cooks very well.

pairs.spanish: No hay ningún libro aquí que me interese.
pairs.english: There is no book here that interests me.

pairs.spanish: ¿Hay algún plomero que pueda venir hoy?
pairs.english: Is there a plumber who can come today?

pairs.spanish: Necesito un cargador que sirva.
pairs.english: I need a charger that works (any that works).

pairs.spanish: Tengo un cargador que sirve.
pairs.english: I have a charger that works (this one).

pairs.spanish: Busco la tienda que está cerca de la oficina.
pairs.english: I'm looking for the shop that is near the office (I know which one).

pairs.spanish: Busco una tienda que esté cerca de la oficina.
pairs.english: I'm looking for a shop that is near the office (any shop).

pairs.spanish: Tengo una amiga con la que puedo hablar de todo.
pairs.english: I have a friend I can talk to about everything (a real friend).

pairs.spanish: Necesito una amiga con la que pueda hablar de todo.
pairs.english: I need a friend I can talk to about everything (I don't have one yet).

pairs.spanish: Buscamos un lugar donde podamos trabajar.
pairs.english: We are looking for a place where we can work.

pairs.spanish: No hay nadie en quien confíe tanto como en ti.
pairs.english: There is nobody I trust as much as you.

pairs.spanish: Buscamos a alguien que sepa trabajar en equipo.
pairs.english: We are looking for someone who knows how to work in a team.

pairs.spanish: Quiero un trabajo que pague bien y tenga un buen horario.
pairs.english: I want a job that pays well and has good hours.

pairs.spanish: Contrataron a una candidata que habla inglés y tiene mucha experiencia.
pairs.english: They hired a candidate who speaks English and has a lot of experience.

pairs.spanish: Todavía no hay ningún candidato que tenga todos los requisitos.
pairs.english: There is still no candidate who has all the requirements.

pairs.spanish: Cualquier persona que llegue tarde tiene que esperar.
pairs.english: Anyone who arrives late has to wait.

pairs.spanish: Quienquiera que haya llamado, no dejó ningún recado.
pairs.english: Whoever called, left no message.

pairs.spanish: Dondequiera que estés, piensa en nosotros.
pairs.english: Wherever you are, think of us.

pairs.spanish: Cualquier cosa que necesites, dímelo.
pairs.english: Anything you need, tell me.

pairs.spanish: Por mucha hambre que tengas, espera a los demás.
pairs.english: However hungry you are, wait for the others.

pairs.spanish: Cualquiera que sea el precio, voy a comprar el boleto.
pairs.english: Whatever the price is, I'm going to buy the ticket.

pairs.spanish: Por más que ahorres, ese viaje sigue siendo caro.
pairs.english: However much you save, that trip is still expensive.

pairs.spanish: Por mucha prisa que tenía, llegó tarde.
pairs.english: However much of a hurry he was in, he arrived late. (It really happened: indicative.)

pairs.spanish: Llame quien llame, no abras la puerta.
pairs.english: Whoever calls, don't open the door.

pairs.spanish: Sea cual sea el resultado, vamos a aceptarlo.
pairs.english: Whatever the result is, we're going to accept it.

pairs.spanish: Opinen lo que opinen, tú decides.
pairs.english: Whatever they think, you decide.

pairs.spanish: Vaya donde vaya, siempre llama a su madre.
pairs.english: Wherever she goes, she always calls her mother.

pairs.spanish: Todo aquel que quiera ayudar es bienvenido.
pairs.english: Anyone who wants to help is welcome.

pairs.spanish: Cuenta todo lo que sepas.
pairs.english: Tell everything you know.

pairs.spanish: Todos los que llegaron temprano recibieron un regalo.
pairs.english: Everyone who arrived early received a gift.

pairs.spanish: Invita a cuantos amigos quieras.
pairs.english: Invite as many friends as you like.

pairs.spanish: Todo aquel que desee participar deberá llenar el formulario.
pairs.english: Anyone who wishes to take part must fill in the form.

pairs.spanish: Cualquier persona que llegue tarde no podrá entrar.
pairs.english: Anyone who arrives late will not be able to come in.

pairs.spanish: Estimados vecinos: se ruega no dejar bolsas en la puerta.
pairs.english: Dear neighbours: please do not leave bags at the door.

pairs.spanish: Quienes deseen más información pueden llamar a la oficina.
pairs.english: Those who would like more information can call the office.

pairs.spanish: Mi jefe quería que termináramos el informe hoy.
pairs.english: My boss wanted us to finish the report today.

pairs.spanish: Nos pidieron que trajéramos los documentos.
pairs.english: They asked us to bring the documents.

pairs.spanish: Le dije que leyese el contrato con cuidado.
pairs.english: I told him to read the contract carefully.

pairs.spanish: No creía que ellos dijeran la verdad.
pairs.english: I did not think they were telling the truth.

pairs.spanish: Si pudiera, dormiría hasta tarde.
pairs.english: If I could, I would sleep late.

pairs.spanish: Mi abuelo quería que estudiáramos medicina.
pairs.english: My grandfather wanted us to study medicine.

pairs.spanish: El director pidió que los alumnos leyesen el reglamento.
pairs.english: The director asked the students to read the rules.

pairs.spanish: Si la ley fuese más clara, habría menos problemas.
pairs.english: If the law were clearer, there would be fewer problems.

pairs.spanish: Buenos días, quisiera que me ayudara con este documento.
pairs.english: Good morning, I would like you to help me with this document.

pairs.spanish: ¿Pudiera esperar un momento, por favor?
pairs.english: Could you wait a moment, please?

pairs.spanish: Debiéramos revisar el contrato antes de firmarlo.
pairs.english: We ought to check the contract before signing it.

pairs.spanish: Mi compañero habla como si fuera el jefe de la oficina.
pairs.english: My colleague talks as if he were the boss of the office.

pairs.spanish: Me trató como si fuéramos viejos amigos.
pairs.english: He treated me as if we were old friends.

pairs.spanish: Ojalá supiera la respuesta.
pairs.english: I wish I knew the answer.

pairs.spanish: Rómulo Gallegos, que fuera presidente de Venezuela en 1948, murió en 1969.
pairs.english: Rómulo Gallegos, who was president of Venezuela in 1948, died in 1969.

pairs.spanish: El pueblo donde naciera la escritora es hoy una ciudad grande.
pairs.english: The town where the writer was born is a large city today.

pairs.spanish: La cronista recordó el golpe que derrocara al presidente.
pairs.english: The reporter recalled the coup that had overthrown the president.

pairs.spanish: Si hubiéramos salido antes, habríamos llegado a tiempo.
pairs.english: If we had left earlier, we would have arrived on time.

pairs.spanish: Si lo hubiese sabido, te habría llamado.
pairs.english: If I had known, I would have called you.

pairs.spanish: Hubiera dicho la verdad, nadie se habría molestado.
pairs.english: Had he told the truth, nobody would have been upset.

pairs.spanish: No creía que hubieran terminado tan pronto.
pairs.english: I did not think they had finished so soon.

pairs.spanish: Ojalá hubiéramos salido más temprano.
pairs.english: I wish we had left earlier.

pairs.spanish: Ojalá me hubieras avisado.
pairs.english: I wish you had told me.

pairs.spanish: Ojalá no hubiese dicho eso.
pairs.english: I wish I had not said that.

pairs.spanish: ¡Quién hubiera estado allí!
pairs.english: If only I had been there!

pairs.spanish: ¡Quién lo hubiera sabido antes!
pairs.english: If only I had known it before!

pairs.spanish: De haber revisado el puente, no habría ocurrido el derrumbe.
pairs.english: Had they checked the bridge, the collapse would not have happened.

pairs.spanish: De no haber llovido, la fiesta habría sido en el patio.
pairs.english: Had it not rained, the party would have been in the courtyard.

pairs.spanish: De haberme avisado, habría ido contigo.
pairs.english: Had you told me, I would have gone with you.

pairs.spanish: Fue una lástima que no hubieras venido a la fiesta.
pairs.english: It was a pity that you had not come to the party.

pairs.spanish: Dudaba que lo hubiesen decidido tan rápido.
pairs.english: I doubted that they had decided it so fast.

pairs.spanish: Habría sido más oportuno que nos hubieran avisado antes.
pairs.english: It would have been more timely if they had warned us earlier.

pairs.spanish: Aunque nadie lo hubiese dicho antes, todos lo sabían.
pairs.english: Although nobody had said it before, everyone knew it.

pairs.spanish: Si hubiésemos sabido la verdad, habríamos actuado de otra manera.
pairs.english: If we had known the truth, we would have acted differently.

pairs.spanish: Ojalá hubiese leído ese prólogo antes.
pairs.english: I wish I had read that preface before.

pairs.spanish: Me dijo que vive en Lima.
pairs.english: He told me that he lives in Lima. (He still does.)

pairs.spanish: Me dijo que vivía en Lima.
pairs.english: He told me that he lived in Lima. (This does not say whether he still does.)

pairs.spanish: Ana dijo que la reunión es mañana.
pairs.english: Ana said that the meeting is tomorrow. (She said it today.)

pairs.spanish: Ana dice que llega tarde.
pairs.english: Ana says that she is arriving late.

pairs.spanish: Luis dijo que se mudaría a Lima, pero no se mudó.
pairs.english: Luis said that he would move to Lima, but he did not.

pairs.spanish: Me preguntó si había comido.
pairs.english: She asked me if I had eaten.

pairs.spanish: Quiso saber cuándo saldrían.
pairs.english: He wanted to know when they would leave.

pairs.spanish: Luis se preguntaba si Ana había recibido su mensaje.
pairs.english: Luis was wondering whether Ana had received his message.

pairs.spanish: No sabía dónde estaban las llaves.
pairs.english: He did not know where the keys were.

pairs.spanish: Luis me pidió que cerrara la ventana.
pairs.english: Luis asked me to close the window.

pairs.spanish: Ana me ha pedido que te llame esta tarde.
pairs.english: Ana has asked me to call you this afternoon.

pairs.spanish: El médico me dijo que descansara unos días.
pairs.english: The doctor told me to rest for a few days.

pairs.spanish: Nos pidieron que no habláramos en voz alta.
pairs.english: They asked us not to talk loudly.

pairs.spanish: Ana dijo que estaría allí al día siguiente.
pairs.english: Ana said that she would be there the next day.

pairs.spanish: Me contó que aquella semana había estado muy ocupada.
pairs.english: She told me that she had been very busy that week.

pairs.spanish: Me dijo que fuera a su casa al día siguiente.
pairs.english: She told me to go to her house the next day.

pairs.spanish: Dijo que llegaba hoy.
pairs.english: He said that he was arriving today. (Said the same day.)

pairs.spanish: Ana miró el reloj. ¿Dónde estaba Pedro?
pairs.english: Ana looked at the clock. Where was Pedro?

pairs.spanish: Luis abrió la carta. ¡Por fin! Mañana mismo se lo diría a todos.
pairs.english: Luis opened the letter. At last! He would tell everyone tomorrow.

pairs.spanish: El jefe leyó el informe. ¿Quién lo había escrito? Aquello no tenía sentido.
pairs.english: The boss read the report. Who had written it? That made no sense.

pairs.spanish: Afirmó que la tienda cerraba a las ocho.
pairs.english: He stated that the shop closed at eight.

pairs.spanish: Explicó que no tenía tiempo.
pairs.english: She explained that she had no time.

pairs.spanish: Añadió que volvería al día siguiente.
pairs.english: He added that he would come back the next day.

pairs.spanish: Admitió que se había equivocado.
pairs.english: She admitted that she had made a mistake.

pairs.spanish: Negó que fuera su error.
pairs.english: He denied that it was his mistake.

pairs.spanish: Me advirtió que el tren salía a las ocho.
pairs.english: He warned me that the train left at eight.

pairs.spanish: Me advirtió que no llegara tarde.
pairs.english: He warned me not to be late.

pairs.spanish: Me reprochó que no hubiera llamado.
pairs.english: She reproached me for not having called.

pairs.spanish: Luis negó que Ana hubiera llegado tarde.
pairs.english: Luis denied that Ana had arrived late.

pairs.spanish: Meg negó haber visto el mensaje.
pairs.english: Meg denied having seen the message.

pairs.spanish: Carlos admitió que había hecho el trabajo.
pairs.english: Carlos admitted that he had done the work.

pairs.spanish: Ana replicó que ya había avisado a todos.
pairs.english: Ana answered back that she had already told everyone.

pairs.spanish: Nos advirtió que el puente estaba cerrado.
pairs.english: He warned us that the bridge was closed.

pairs.spanish: Nos advirtió que no cruzáramos.
pairs.english: He warned us not to cross.

pairs.spanish: Me recordó que la tienda cerraba a las ocho.
pairs.english: She reminded me that the shop closed at eight.

pairs.spanish: Me recordó que cerrara la puerta.
pairs.english: She reminded me to close the door.

pairs.spanish: Ana me reprochó que no hubiera llamado antes.
pairs.english: Ana reproached me for not having called earlier.

pairs.spanish: Me echó en cara que no la hubiera ayudado.
pairs.english: She threw it in my face that I had not helped her.

pairs.spanish: Me acusó de haber olvidado la llave.
pairs.english: He accused me of having forgotten the key.

pairs.spanish: Los vecinos culparon al alcalde del problema.
pairs.english: The neighbours blamed the mayor for the problem.

pairs.spanish: Según el vecino, el río subió mucho anoche.
pairs.english: According to the neighbour, the river rose a lot last night.

pairs.spanish: Al parecer, el director ya había salido de la oficina.
pairs.english: Apparently, the director had already left the office.

pairs.spanish: El presunto culpable negó haber estado allí.
pairs.english: The alleged culprit denied having been there.

pairs.spanish: Se dice que la tienda cerró el mes pasado.
pairs.english: It is said that the shop closed last month.

pairs.spanish: Se necesitan dos boletos para entrar.
pairs.english: Two tickets are needed to get in.

pairs.spanish: Aquí se pueden comprar boletos.
pairs.english: You can buy tickets here.

pairs.spanish: Se debe cerrar la puerta.
pairs.english: The door must be closed.

pairs.spanish: Se deben cerrar las ventanas.
pairs.english: The windows must be closed.

pairs.spanish: Los acuerdos se firmaron ayer.
pairs.english: The agreements were signed yesterday.

pairs.spanish: Se atendió a todos los clientes.
pairs.english: All the customers were served.

pairs.spanish: Se atendieron las llamadas.
pairs.english: The calls were answered.

pairs.spanish: Se invitó a los vecinos.
pairs.english: The neighbours were invited.

pairs.spanish: Se trabaja mucho en esta oficina.
pairs.english: People work a lot in this office.

pairs.spanish: Se publicaron los resultados ayer.
pairs.english: The results were published yesterday.

pairs.spanish: Los resultados fueron publicados por la directora.
pairs.english: The results were published by the director.

pairs.spanish: La directora publicó los resultados.
pairs.english: The director published the results.

pairs.spanish: Se compran boletos por internet.
pairs.english: Tickets are bought online.

pairs.spanish: Se admiten perros pequeños.
pairs.english: Small dogs are allowed.

pairs.spanish: Se recomienda llegar temprano.
pairs.english: Arriving early is recommended.

pairs.spanish: Se pelan las papas y se cortan en trozos.
pairs.english: The potatoes are peeled and cut into pieces.

pairs.spanish: Se agrega un poco de sal.
pairs.english: A little salt is added.

pairs.spanish: Se ven todos los días.
pairs.english: They see each other every day.

pairs.spanish: Se ven las montañas desde aquí.
pairs.english: The mountains can be seen from here.

pairs.spanish: Se me perdieron las llaves.
pairs.english: I lost my keys.

pairs.spanish: Se nos olvidó el boleto.
pairs.english: We forgot the ticket.

pairs.spanish: La novela fue publicada en 1919.
pairs.english: The novel was published in 1919.

pairs.spanish: La universidad fue fundada por un grupo de estudiantes.
pairs.english: The university was founded by a group of students.

pairs.spanish: Las obras han sido anunciadas.
pairs.english: The works have been announced.

pairs.spanish: La carta fue escrita por mi abuelo.
pairs.english: The letter was written by my grandfather.

pairs.spanish: El premio fue entregado por el alcalde.
pairs.english: The prize was handed over by the mayor.

pairs.spanish: Los cuadros fueron dañados por el agua.
pairs.english: The paintings were damaged by the water.

pairs.spanish: El museo fue clausurado en junio y sigue cerrado.
pairs.english: The museum was closed down in June and is still shut.

pairs.spanish: Los cuadros están dañados por el agua.
pairs.english: The paintings are damaged by the water.

pairs.spanish: La carta ya está escrita.
pairs.english: The letter is already written.

pairs.spanish: Ya hemos imprimido los boletos.
pairs.english: We have already printed the tickets.

pairs.spanish: Los boletos ya están impresos.
pairs.english: The tickets are already printed.

pairs.spanish: El presidente electo visitó la escuela.
pairs.english: The president-elect visited the school.

pairs.spanish: Se anunciaron los resultados esta mañana.
pairs.english: The results were announced this morning.

pairs.spanish: Los resultados fueron anunciados por el jurado.
pairs.english: The results were announced by the jury.

pairs.spanish: Los resultados ya están anunciados.
pairs.english: The results have already been announced.

pairs.spanish: Dicen que mañana va a llover.
pairs.english: They say it is going to rain tomorrow.

pairs.spanish: Aquí no dejan entrar a nadie.
pairs.english: They do not let anybody in here.

pairs.spanish: Uno aprende con la práctica.
pairs.english: You learn with practice.

pairs.spanish: Cuando uno viaja mucho, extraña su casa.
pairs.english: When you travel a lot, you miss your home.

pairs.spanish: Cuando se es joven, se aprende rápido.
pairs.english: When you are young, you learn quickly.

pairs.spanish: Cuando se está lejos, se extraña a la familia.
pairs.english: When you are far away, you miss your family.

pairs.spanish: Cuando uno se muda a otra ciudad, extraña a su familia.
pairs.english: When you move to another city, you miss your family.

pairs.spanish: Me robaron el celular en el autobús.
pairs.english: Somebody stole my phone on the bus.

pairs.spanish: La subida de los precios preocupa a muchas familias.
pairs.english: The rise in prices worries many families.

pairs.spanish: El aumento del tráfico molesta a los vecinos.
pairs.english: The increase in traffic bothers the neighbours.

pairs.spanish: La llegada del tren se anunció a las ocho.
pairs.english: The arrival of the train was announced at eight.

pairs.spanish: El cambio de horario sorprendió a todos.
pairs.english: The change of schedule surprised everyone.

pairs.spanish: Hace falta que cada uno traiga algo de comer.
pairs.english: Everyone needs to bring something to eat.

pairs.spanish: Basta con que nos avises un día antes.
pairs.english: It is enough that you let us know a day before.

pairs.spanish: Urge que arreglen la puerta de la oficina.
pairs.english: It is urgent that they fix the office door.

pairs.spanish: Hace falta un plan nuevo.
pairs.english: A new plan is needed.

pairs.spanish: Parece que va a llover toda la tarde.
pairs.english: It looks like it will rain all afternoon.

pairs.spanish: Según parece, el director no puede venir hoy.
pairs.english: Apparently the director cannot come today.

pairs.spanish: Podría decirse que fue un buen año para la empresa.
pairs.english: One could say it was a good year for the company.

pairs.spanish: Tal vez convendría hablar con la jefa antes de decidir.
pairs.english: Perhaps it would be a good idea to talk to the boss before deciding.

pairs.spanish: Mi hermano se puso rojo de vergüenza.
pairs.english: My brother went red with embarrassment.

pairs.spanish: Cuando entró el jefe, todos nos quedamos callados.
pairs.english: When the boss came in, we all fell silent.

pairs.spanish: Se puso a llorar.
pairs.english: She started to cry.

pairs.spanish: Mi vecina estudió música y se hizo profesora.
pairs.english: My neighbour studied music and became a teacher.

pairs.spanish: Desde que cambió de trabajo, se ha vuelto más serio.
pairs.english: Since he changed jobs, he has become more serious.

pairs.spanish: Se hizo el sordo cuando le pedí el dinero.
pairs.english: He pretended not to hear when I asked him for the money.

pairs.spanish: La estación vieja se convirtió en un hotel.
pairs.english: The old station became a hotel.

pairs.spanish: La fama la convirtió en otra persona.
pairs.english: Fame turned her into a different person.

pairs.spanish: Con tanta lluvia, el camino se transformó en barro.
pairs.english: With so much rain, the road turned into mud.

pairs.spanish: Quiero llegar a ser una buena cocinera.
pairs.english: I want to become a good cook.

pairs.spanish: Con el tiempo, llegó a ser muy famoso.
pairs.english: With time, he became very famous.

pairs.spanish: Puede llegar a ser un gran músico.
pairs.english: He could become a great musician.

pairs.spanish: Al oír el precio, mi madre palideció.
pairs.english: On hearing the price, my mother turned pale.

pairs.spanish: Con el comercio, el pueblo se enriqueció.
pairs.english: With trade, the town became rich.

pairs.spanish: El público enmudeció cuando apareció el cantante.
pairs.english: The audience fell silent when the singer appeared.

pairs.spanish: Llevábamos una hora esperando cuando llegó el tren.
pairs.english: We had been waiting for an hour when the train arrived.

pairs.spanish: Llevo una semana sin dormir bien.
pairs.english: I have not slept well for a week.

pairs.spanish: La propuesta deriva de un estudio.
pairs.english: The proposal comes from a study.

pairs.spanish: El estudio derivó en una propuesta.
pairs.english: The study led to a proposal.

pairs.spanish: El libro trata de dos hermanos.
pairs.english: The book is about two brothers.

pairs.spanish: Trato de llegar temprano.
pairs.english: I try to arrive early.

pairs.spanish: Por un lado, el piso es barato; por otro, está lejos del centro.
pairs.english: On the one hand, the flat is cheap; on the other, it is far from the centre.

pairs.spanish: En primer lugar, el barrio es tranquilo; en segundo lugar, hay un parque cerca.
pairs.english: Firstly, the neighbourhood is quiet; secondly, there is a park nearby.

pairs.spanish: Habla tan rápido que no lo entiendo.
pairs.english: He speaks so fast that I do not understand him.

pairs.spanish: Tenía tantos problemas que no sabía por dónde empezar.
pairs.english: I had so many problems that I did not know where to start.

pairs.spanish: Trabaja tanto que casi no duerme.
pairs.english: He works so much that he hardly sleeps.

pairs.spanish: Explicó el plan de tal modo que nadie tuvo dudas.
pairs.english: He explained the plan in such a way that nobody had doubts.

pairs.spanish: El plan es caro y no hay tiempo. Así pues, buscamos otra solución.
pairs.english: The plan is expensive and there is no time. So, we are looking for another solution.

pairs.spanish: —Hace mucho frío. —Entonces nos quedamos dentro.
pairs.english: "It is very cold." "Then we stay inside."

pairs.spanish: —¿Por qué llegas tarde? —Es que perdí el autobús.
pairs.english: "Why are you late?" "The thing is that I missed the bus."

pairs.spanish: —¿Quieres venir? —Es que tengo que trabajar.
pairs.english: "Do you want to come?" "The thing is that I have to work."

pairs.spanish: No es que no quiera ir, sino que no puedo.
pairs.english: It is not that I do not want to go, it is that I cannot.

pairs.spanish: No es que sea caro, sino que no lo necesito.
pairs.english: It is not that it is expensive, it is that I do not need it.

pairs.spanish: Por poco que ahorres, algo te quedará.
pairs.english: However little you save, you will have something left.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Por poca gente que venga, la fiesta será un éxito.
pairs.english: However few people come, the party will be a success.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Por muy bien que cocine, no quiere abrir un restaurante.
pairs.english: However well he cooks, he does not want to open a restaurant.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Por poco que comió, se sintió mal.
pairs.english: However little he ate, he felt ill. (It really happened: indicative.)
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Lo dijo aun a riesgo de perder su trabajo.
pairs.english: He said it even at the risk of losing his job.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Lo dijo aun a riesgo de que nadie le creyera.
pairs.english: He said it even at the risk of nobody believing him.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Voy a ir, así llueva.
pairs.english: I am going to go, even if it rains.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Voy a comprarlo, así cueste mucho dinero.
pairs.english: I am going to buy it, even if it costs a lot of money.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Cueste lo que cueste, terminaremos el trabajo.
pairs.english: Whatever it takes, we will finish the work.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Pase lo que pase, te voy a apoyar.
pairs.english: Come what may, I am going to support you.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Costara lo que costara, estaban decididos a ganar.
pairs.english: Whatever it cost, they were determined to win.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Quieras o no, tienes que ir.
pairs.english: Whether you like it or not, you have to go.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Habla como si lo supiera todo.
pairs.english: He talks as if he knew everything.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Habló de la selva como si la hubiera visto.
pairs.english: He spoke about the jungle as if he had seen it.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Me trató igual que si fuera de la familia.
pairs.english: She treated me just as if I were part of the family.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Actuó lo mismo que si no hubiera pasado nada.
pairs.english: He acted just as if nothing had happened.
pairs.topic: Subordinación adverbial I: Concesivas avanzadas y modales

pairs.spanish: Si tiene fiebre, tiene que ir al médico.
pairs.english: If he has a fever, he has to go to the doctor.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: Si ya salió, llegará pronto.
pairs.english: If he has already left, he will arrive soon.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: Si no contesta, estará ocupado.
pairs.english: If he does not answer, he must be busy.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: De ser necesario, te llamo mañana.
pairs.english: If it is necessary, I will call you tomorrow.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: Ojalá hubiera estudiado más.
pairs.english: I wish I had studied more.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: Si lo hubiera sabido, habría venido.
pairs.english: If I had known, I would have come.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: De haberlo sabido, habría venido.
pairs.english: Had I known, I would have come.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: De haberte visto, te habría saludado.
pairs.english: Had I seen you, I would have said hello.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: Debería haber llamado.
pairs.english: I should have called.
pairs.topic: B2.33 Subordinación adverbial II: Condicionales complejas y contrafácticas

pairs.spanish: Mi auto está cerca de la oficina.
pairs.english: My car is near the office.
pairs.topic: B2.34 Sociolingüística y variación dialectal II: Léxico, registros y pragmática

pairs.spanish: Mi celular no funciona.
pairs.english: My mobile phone does not work.
pairs.topic: B2.34 Sociolingüística y variación dialectal II: Léxico, registros y pragmática

pairs.spanish: Vivo en un departamento pequeño en el centro.
pairs.english: I live in a small flat in the centre.
pairs.topic: B2.34 Sociolingüística y variación dialectal II: Léxico, registros y pragmática

pairs.spanish: El aumento de los precios preocupa a las familias.
pairs.english: The rise in prices worries families.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: La llegada del presidente se anunció ayer.
pairs.english: The president's arrival was announced yesterday.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: La rapidez del cambio sorprendió a todos.
pairs.english: The speed of the change surprised everyone.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: Debido a la dificultad del examen, muchos estudiantes protestaron.
pairs.english: Because of the difficulty of the exam, many students protested.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: Se aprobó la nueva ley ayer.
pairs.english: The new law was passed yesterday.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: Se espera que las cifras mejoren.
pairs.english: The figures are expected to improve.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: Se estima que hay más de mil personas.
pairs.english: It is estimated that there are more than a thousand people.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: El aumento de los precios preocupa a muchas familias.
pairs.english: The rise in prices worries many families.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: Si bien es cierto que los salarios han subido, no lo han hecho tanto como los precios.
pairs.english: It is true that wages have risen, but not as much as prices.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: Aprobada la nueva ley, se espera que la situación mejore.
pairs.english: Once the new law is passed, the situation is expected to improve.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: En conclusión, el aumento de los precios exige medidas.
pairs.english: In conclusion, the rise in prices calls for measures.
pairs.topic: B2.35 Registros formales, ensayísticos y de prensa

pairs.spanish: El tiempo es un río.
pairs.english: Time is a river. (metaphor)
pairs.topic: B2.36 Síntesis B2: La voz propia en español

pairs.spanish: ¿Quién puede negar que los precios suben?
pairs.english: Who can deny that prices are rising? (rhetorical question)
pairs.topic: B2.36 Síntesis B2: La voz propia en español

pairs.spanish: Trabajo, trabajo y más trabajo: así se aprende.
pairs.english: Work, work and more work: that is how one learns. (repetition)
pairs.topic: B2.36 Síntesis B2: La voz propia en español

pairs.spanish: El aumento de los precios preocupa a muchas familias.
pairs.english: The rise in prices worries many families.
pairs.topic: B2.36 Síntesis B2: La voz propia en español

pairs.spanish: Si bien es cierto que los salarios han subido, no han subido tanto como los precios.
pairs.english: It is true that wages have risen, but not as much as prices.
pairs.topic: B2.36 Síntesis B2: La voz propia en español

pairs.spanish: No cabe duda de que se necesitan medidas.
pairs.english: There is no doubt that measures are needed.
pairs.topic: B2.36 Síntesis B2: La voz propia en español

pairs.spanish: ¿Quién puede negar que el problema es real?
pairs.english: Who can deny that the problem is real?

pairs.spanish: Los ocho países firmaron el tratado para que la región tuviera una política común.
pairs.english: The eight countries signed the treaty so that the region would have a common policy.

pairs.spanish: Los científicos miden la deforestación para que los gobiernos conozcan los datos.
pairs.english: Scientists measure deforestation so that governments know the figures.

pairs.spanish: Los países se reúnen para decidir acciones conjuntas.
pairs.english: The countries meet to decide joint actions.

pairs.spanish: Hay una isla que pertenece a Perú.
pairs.english: There is an island that belongs to Peru.

pairs.spanish: No hay ningún puente que una las dos orillas en ese punto.
pairs.english: There is no bridge that joins the two banks at that point.

pairs.spanish: Necesitamos una escuela que enseñe en los dos idiomas.
pairs.english: We need a school that teaches in both languages.

pairs.spanish: Debido a la deforestación, algunos científicos temen menos lluvia.
pairs.english: Because of deforestation, some scientists fear less rain.

pairs.spanish: A raíz de los estudios del INPE, se conocen mejor los datos de la selva.
pairs.english: As a result of INPE's studies, the data on the forest are better known.

pairs.spanish: Debido a la humedad de la selva, llueve casi todos los días en algunas zonas.
pairs.english: Because of the forest's humidity, it rains almost every day in some areas.

pairs.spanish: Un pez que come otros peces puede tener más mercurio.
pairs.english: A fish that eats other fish may have more mercury.

pairs.spanish: Debe de haber mucho mercurio en ese tramo del río.
pairs.english: There must be a lot of mercury in that stretch of the river.

pairs.spanish: Tiene que ser mercurio: el análisis lo muestra.
pairs.english: It has to be mercury: the analysis shows it.

pairs.spanish: Si el caucho no se hubiera producido en Asia, hoy Manaus quizá tendría otra economía.
pairs.english: If rubber had not been produced in Asia, Manaus might have a different economy today.

pairs.spanish: Si hubieras comprado castañas en Belém, ahora tendrías un buen recuerdo.
pairs.english: If you had bought nuts in Belém, you would have a good souvenir now.

pairs.spanish: Si no hubiera existido la minería, los ríos estarían hoy más limpios.
pairs.english: If mining had not existed, the rivers would be cleaner today.

pairs.spanish: Mediante el relleno con escombros, se ganó tierra al río.
pairs.english: By means of landfill, land was won from the river.

pairs.spanish: Debido a la poca profundidad de la costa, los barcos grandes anclaban lejos.
pairs.english: Because of the shallow coast, big ships anchored far away.

pairs.spanish: A raíz del tamaño de los barcos, Puerto Madero quedó pequeño.
pairs.english: As a result of the size of the ships, Puerto Madero became too small.

pairs.spanish: Mediante nuevos parques y avenidas, la ciudad cambió de aspecto.
pairs.english: By means of new parks and avenues, the city changed its look.

pairs.spanish: El barrio se iba llenando de familias que venían de Italia y de España.
pairs.english: The neighbourhood was gradually filling up with families from Italy and Spain.

pairs.spanish: Los barcos iban llegando al puerto cada semana.
pairs.english: Ships kept arriving at the port every week.

pairs.spanish: Muchos inmigrantes seguían hablando su lengua en casa.
pairs.english: Many immigrants still spoke their language at home.

pairs.spanish: El italiano y el español se iban mezclando en la calle.
pairs.english: Italian and Spanish were gradually mixing in the street.

pairs.spanish: El bandoneón fue traído desde Alemania.
pairs.english: The bandoneón was brought from Germany.

pairs.spanish: Muchos tangos fueron cantados por Carlos Gardel.
pairs.english: Many tangos were sung by Carlos Gardel.

pairs.spanish: El tango fue llevado a Europa por músicos y bailarines.
pairs.english: Tango was taken to Europe by musicians and dancers.

pairs.spanish: El tango fue declarado Patrimonio Cultural Inmaterial por la UNESCO en 2009.
pairs.english: Tango was declared Intangible Cultural Heritage by UNESCO in 2009.

pairs.spanish: En resumen, los cafés y las librerías son lugares para conversar.
pairs.english: In short, cafés and bookshops are places for conversation.

pairs.spanish: Lo más importante es que los cafés sirven para conversar sin prisa.
pairs.english: The most important thing is that cafés are for talking without hurry.

pairs.spanish: El periodista destaca que los cafés son lugares de encuentro.
pairs.english: The journalist stresses that cafés are meeting places.

pairs.spanish: En resumen, la ciudad lee, conversa y piensa mucho.
pairs.english: In short, the city reads, talks and thinks a lot.

pairs.spanish: En una librería de la calle Corrientes habrá alguien comprando un libro de Borges.
pairs.english: In a bookshop on Corrientes Street, someone is probably buying a book by Borges.

pairs.spanish: No hay cifras exactas, pero serán millones de lectores.
pairs.english: There are no exact figures, but they are probably millions of readers.

pairs.spanish: En este momento alguien estará leyendo Rayuela en un café.
pairs.english: Right now someone is probably reading Rayuela in a café.

pairs.spanish: Ficciones tendrá lectores en muchos países.
pairs.english: Ficciones probably has readers in many countries.

pairs.spanish: Si bien la pampa parece plana, tiene paisajes muy variados.
pairs.english: Although the pampa looks flat, it has very varied landscapes.

pairs.spanish: Si bien el gaucho fue una figura real, su imagen es en parte un mito.
pairs.english: Although the gaucho was a real figure, his image is partly a myth.

pairs.spanish: La vida del campo, si bien cambió mucho, conserva sus tradiciones.
pairs.english: Country life, although it changed a lot, keeps its traditions.

pairs.spanish: Si bien trabajaban con el ganado, muchos gauchos eran peones.
pairs.english: Although they worked with cattle, many gauchos were farmhands.

pairs.spanish: Con el tiempo, el malbec llegó a convertirse en la uva más conocida del país.
pairs.english: In time, Malbec became the best-known grape of the country.

pairs.spanish: Algunas viñas llegan a estar a mucha altura.
pairs.english: Some vineyards get to be at a great height.

pairs.spanish: Si llega a faltar nieve en invierno, hay menos agua en verano.
pairs.english: If there happens to be little snow in winter, there is less water in summer.

pairs.spanish: El viaje llegó a ser largo, pero valió la pena.
pairs.english: The trip ended up being long, but it was worth it.

pairs.spanish: La quebrada es seca; sin embargo, muchas comunidades viven allí desde hace siglos.
pairs.english: The ravine is dry; however, many communities have lived there for centuries.

pairs.spanish: El camino es largo; no obstante, muchas caravanas lo recorrían.
pairs.english: The road is long; nevertheless, many caravans travelled it.

pairs.spanish: Aunque la zona es seca, se cultivan maíz y papas en los valles bajos.
pairs.english: Although the area is dry, corn and potatoes are grown in the lower valleys.

pairs.spanish: Hay poca agua. Sin embargo, hay cultivos en los valles bajos.
pairs.english: There is little water. However, there are crops in the lower valleys.

pairs.spanish: A pesar de las dificultades del clima, los colonos galeses se quedaron.
pairs.english: Despite the difficulties of the climate, the Welsh settlers stayed.

pairs.spanish: A pesar de que la tierra era seca, los colonos no se fueron.
pairs.english: Although the land was dry, the settlers did not leave.

pairs.spanish: Pese a las malas cosechas, los colonos no se fueron.
pairs.english: Despite the bad harvests, the settlers did not leave.

pairs.spanish: A pesar de ser una región fría, la Patagonia recibe muchos visitantes.
pairs.english: Despite being a cold region, Patagonia receives many visitors.

pairs.spanish: El viejo tren terminó por convertirse en una atracción turística.
pairs.english: The old train ended up as a tourist attraction.

pairs.spanish: El pueblo terminó por crecer alrededor del puerto.
pairs.english: The village ended up growing around the port.

pairs.spanish: La cárcel acabó por cerrarse en 1947.
pairs.english: The prison ended up closing in 1947.

pairs.spanish: Con el tiempo, muchos viajeros acaban por visitar el canal Beagle.
pairs.english: In time, many travellers end up visiting the Beagle Channel.

pairs.spanish: Aun cuando México no se hubiera unido al MILA en 2014, el mercado habría seguido con tres bolsas.

pairs.spanish: El puerto de Chancay es tan profundo que recibe barcos muy grandes.
pairs.english: The port of Chancay is so deep that it receives very large ships.

pairs.spanish: Nieva tanto en la cordillera que, a veces, el paso de Los Libertadores se cierra.

pairs.spanish: Los Andes son tan altos que durante siglos separaron la costa del Pacífico del interior.

pairs.english: As Paraguay's consumption grows, less energy is left to sell to Brazil.

pairs.spanish: A medida que aumenta la demanda, las centrales producen más.
pairs.english: As demand increases, the power stations produce more.

pairs.spanish: Cuanto más se conectan las redes eléctricas, más fácil es compartir electricidad.
pairs.english: The more the electricity grids are connected, the easier it is to share electricity.

pairs.spanish: Cuanto menos llueve en la cuenca del Paraná, menos electricidad producen las centrales.
pairs.english: The less it rains in the Paraná basin, the less electricity the power stations produce.

pairs.spanish: Es importante que los países reconozcan los documentos de identidad de los demás.
pairs.english: It is important that countries recognise each other's identity documents.

pairs.spanish: Es necesario que los trabajadores migrantes tengan los mismos derechos que los ciudadanos del país.

pairs.spanish: Es mejor que los trámites sean rápidos.

pairs.spanish: Es una lástima que algunos títulos no se reconozcan en otros países.
pairs.english: It is a pity that some degrees are not recognised in other countries.

pairs.spanish: Lo que más preocupa hoy es el hundimiento del suelo.
pairs.english: What worries people most today is the sinking of the ground.
pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.spanish: Fue en el lago de Texcoco donde el agua era salada.
pairs.english: It was in Lake Texcoco that the water was salty.

pairs.english: It was after the conquest that the authorities began to drain the lakes.

pairs.spanish: Lo que protegía la ciudad eran los diques y las calzadas.
pairs.english: What protected the city were the dikes and the causeways.
pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.spanish: Muy importante fue el albarradón de Nezahualcóyotl para proteger la ciudad.
pairs.english: The dike of Nezahualcóyotl was very important for protecting the city.
pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.spanish: Junto a la catedral aparecieron los restos del Templo Mayor.
pairs.english: Next to the cathedral the remains of the Templo Mayor appeared.
pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.spanish: En realidad, las castas no describían bien la vida de la calle.

pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.spanish: Sor Juana, indudablemente, quería tener tiempo para estudiar.

pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.english: Strictly speaking, the capital of the viceroyalty was Mexico City.
pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.spanish: Lamentablemente, no se conservan todos los retablos de aquella época.

pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.spanish: Precisamente en el convento tuvo Sor Juana tiempo para estudiar.
pairs.english: It was precisely in the convent that Sor Juana had time to study.
pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.english: The murals were not an ornament but a history lesson for the people.

pairs.spanish: No era arte para coleccionistas, sino arte para la calle.

pairs.spanish: No fue el lienzo, sino la pared lo que eligieron los muralistas.
pairs.english: It was not the canvas but the wall that the muralists chose.
pairs.topic: Mexico I: Central Mexico & the Valley of Anáhuac

pairs.topic: Mexico II: The North, the Border & Industrial Modernity

pairs.spanish: Si no hubiera agua suficiente, la industria tendría problemas.
pairs.english: If there were not enough water, industry would have problems.

pairs.spanish: Cuando llegó el barco a Buenos Aires, muchos inmigrantes buscaron trabajo en el puerto.

pairs.spanish: Con miras al desfile, las comparsas afinan los tambores.
pairs.english: With the parade in view, the comparsas tune the drums.

pairs.spanish: Los militares quisieron aprobar una Constitución mediante un plebiscito.
pairs.english: The military wanted to approve a constitution by means of a plebiscite.

pairs.spanish: Los uruguayos expresaron su rechazo mediante el voto.
pairs.english: Uruguayans expressed their rejection by voting.

pairs.spanish: En 1984 volvió el gobierno civil mediante elecciones.
pairs.english: In 1984 civilian government returned by means of elections.

pairs.spanish: El gobierno militar controlaba la información mediante la censura.
pairs.english: The military government controlled information by means of censorship.

pairs.spanish: Después de la energía hidráulica, el país pasó a invertir en energía eólica.
pairs.english: After hydroelectric power, the country went on to invest in wind power.

pairs.spanish: Con el tiempo, el plan pasó a incluir a los alumnos de secundaria.
pairs.english: In time, the plan went on to include secondary students.

pairs.spanish: Ahora pasemos a hablar de la energía renovable.
pairs.english: Now let us move on to talking about renewable energy.

pairs.spanish: Primero se aprobó la ley; después, el Parlamento pasó a discutir otra.
pairs.english: First the law was passed; then Parliament moved on to discuss another.

pairs.spanish: Los visitantes se acostumbran pronto a ver gente con un termo.
pairs.english: Visitors soon get used to seeing people with a thermos.

pairs.spanish: Muchos montevideanos empiezan a cebar el mate por la mañana.
pairs.english: Many people in Montevideo begin to prepare mate in the morning.

pairs.spanish: Un turista se da cuenta de que casi todos llevan un termo.
pairs.english: A tourist realises that almost everyone carries a thermos.

pairs.spanish: Los visitantes se adaptan a la tranquilidad de la rambla.
pairs.english: Visitors adapt to the calm of the rambla.

pairs.spanish: Estrecho es el valle donde está Caracas.
pairs.english: The valley where Caracas lies is narrow.

pairs.spanish: En un valle estrecho fue fundada Caracas en 1567.
pairs.english: Caracas was founded in 1567 in a narrow valley.

pairs.spanish: Entre la ciudad y el mar se levanta El Ávila.
pairs.english: El Ávila rises between the city and the sea.

pairs.spanish: En 1800 subió Humboldt a la Silla de Caracas.
pairs.english: In 1800 Humboldt climbed the Silla de Caracas.

pairs.spanish: Antes de que se descubriera el petróleo, Venezuela vivía del café y del cacao.
pairs.english: Before oil was discovered, Venezuela lived from coffee and cacao.

pairs.spanish: Después de que se abrió el pozo, llegaron muchas empresas.
pairs.english: After the well was opened, many companies arrived.
