pairs.spanish: Antes de que llegara la empresa, el pueblo era tranquilo.
pairs.english: Before the company arrived, the village was quiet.

pairs.spanish: Hablaremos después de que termine la visita.
pairs.english: We will talk after the visit ends.

pairs.spanish: Las Nubes de Calder cuelgan del techo como si fueran nubes de verdad.
pairs.english: Calder's Clouds hang from the ceiling as if they were real clouds.

pairs.spanish: Los estudiantes caminan por el campus como si estuvieran en una ciudad.
pairs.english: The students walk across the campus as if they were in a city.

pairs.spanish: El arquitecto diseñó el campus como si fuera una ciudad.
pairs.english: The architect designed the campus as if it were a city.

pairs.spanish: Habla de arte como si fuera un experto.
pairs.english: He talks about art as if he were an expert.

pairs.spanish: En realidad, Soto nació en Ciudad Bolívar.
pairs.english: Actually, Soto was born in Ciudad Bolívar.

pairs.spanish: Lamentablemente, no puedo ver la exposición esta semana.
pairs.english: Unfortunately, I cannot see the exhibition this week.

pairs.spanish: Francamente, la obra de Cruz-Diez me parece fascinante.
pairs.english: Frankly, Cruz-Diez's work seems fascinating to me.

pairs.spanish: En Ciudad Bolívar, precisamente su ciudad natal, está el Museo Soto.
pairs.english: In Ciudad Bolívar, precisely his home town, is the Soto Museum.

pairs.spanish: Según varios economistas, el país debería haber ahorrado más en los años de precios altos.
pairs.english: According to several economists, the country should have saved more in the years of high prices.

pairs.spanish: Deberían haber usado el dinero para otras industrias, dicen algunos analistas.
pairs.english: They should have used the money for other industries, say some analysts.

pairs.spanish: Deberíamos haber ahorrado más.
pairs.english: We should have saved more.

pairs.spanish: Me arrepiento de no haber ahorrado más.
pairs.english: I regret not having saved more.

pairs.spanish: El llanero es el hombre que cuida el ganado a caballo.
pairs.english: The llanero is the man who looks after the cattle on horseback.

pairs.spanish: El joropo es la música que se baila en los Llanos.
pairs.english: The joropo is the music that is danced in the Llanos.

pairs.spanish: Los Llanos son la región donde viven los llaneros.
pairs.english: The Llanos are the region where the llaneros live.

pairs.spanish: Pedro Elías Gutiérrez, quien compuso «Alma llanera», es conocido en todo el país.
pairs.english: Pedro Elías Gutiérrez, who composed "Alma llanera", is known throughout the country.

pairs.spanish: Lo que más impresiona de Canaima son los tepuyes.
pairs.english: What impresses most about Canaima is the tepuis.

pairs.spanish: Fue el piloto Jimmie Angel quien sobrevoló la cascada en 1933.
pairs.english: It was the pilot Jimmie Angel who flew over the waterfall in 1933.

pairs.spanish: Es en Canaima donde está el Salto Ángel.
pairs.english: It is in Canaima that Angel Falls is.

pairs.spanish: Fue en 1994 cuando la UNESCO declaró Canaima Patrimonio de la Humanidad.
pairs.english: It was in 1994 that UNESCO declared Canaima a World Heritage site.

pairs.spanish: Debido a la caída del precio del petróleo en 2014, los ingresos del país bajaron.
pairs.english: Because of the fall in the oil price in 2014, the country's income fell.

pairs.spanish: A raíz de las sanciones, según el gobierno, bajó la producción de petróleo.
pairs.english: As a result of the sanctions, according to the government, oil production fell.

pairs.spanish: Según los críticos, debido al control de precios, faltaron productos.
pairs.english: According to the critics, because of price controls, goods were missing.

pairs.spanish: Debido a la inflación, los salarios compraban cada vez menos.
pairs.english: Because of inflation, wages bought less and less.

pairs.spanish: Según ACNUR, unos 7,9 millones de venezolanos vivían fuera del país a finales de 2025.
pairs.english: According to UNHCR, about 7.9 million Venezuelans lived outside the country at the end of 2025.

pairs.spanish: ACNUR informó de que muchas personas salieron del país.
pairs.english: UNHCR reported that many people left the country.

pairs.spanish: Según ACNUR, Colombia es el país que más personas venezolanas ha recibido.
pairs.english: According to UNHCR, Colombia is the country that has received the most Venezuelans.

pairs.spanish: ACNUR explica que muchas personas salieron por la crisis económica.
pairs.english: UNHCR explains that many people left because of the economic crisis.

pairs.spanish: Ojalá hubiera podido quedarme con mi familia.
pairs.english: I wish I had been able to stay with my family.

pairs.spanish: Ojalá hubiéramos llevado más harina.
pairs.english: I wish we had taken more flour.

pairs.spanish: Ojalá hubiera salido antes.
pairs.english: I wish I had left earlier.

pairs.spanish: ¡Quién hubiera podido volver antes!
pairs.english: If only I had been able to come back earlier!

pairs.spanish: Mi tesis es que trabajar desde casa mejora los resultados.
pairs.english: My thesis is that working from home improves results.

pairs.spanish: Si bien es cierto que el plan es caro, su ventaja es mayor.
pairs.english: Although it is true that the plan is expensive, its advantage is greater.

pairs.spanish: Quien no esté de acuerdo debe respaldar su postura con datos.
pairs.english: Anyone who does not agree must back up their position with data.

pairs.spanish: El autor fundamenta su tesis en tres ejemplos.
pairs.english: The author bases his thesis on three examples.

pairs.spanish: Tras haber estudiado las dos muestras, el equipo confirmó la hipótesis.
pairs.english: After studying the two samples, the team confirmed the hypothesis.

pairs.spanish: La autora fue criticada por no haber contrastado sus fuentes.
pairs.english: The author was criticised for not having checked her sources.

pairs.spanish: Sin haber leído el informe completo, no se puede juzgar.
pairs.english: Without having read the whole report, one cannot judge.

pairs.spanish: El haber estudiado el tema no basta: hay que saber explicarlo.
pairs.english: Having studied the subject is not enough: you must be able to explain it.

pairs.spanish: La reducción de los desplazamientos incide en el rendimiento.
pairs.english: The reduction in travel affects performance.

pairs.spanish: La validez de los resultados depende de la muestra.
pairs.english: The validity of the results depends on the sample.

pairs.spanish: La fiabilidad del método limita el alcance de la conclusión.
pairs.english: The reliability of the method limits the scope of the conclusion.

pairs.spanish: La valoración de la propuesta exige datos fiables.
pairs.english: The assessment of the proposal requires reliable data.

pairs.spanish: Usamos el término «sesgo» para designar un error que va siempre en la misma dirección.
pairs.english: We use the term "bias" to designate an error that always goes in the same direction.

pairs.spanish: En sentido amplio, el término «trabajador» incluye también a los estudiantes.
pairs.english: In a broad sense, the term "worker" also includes students.

pairs.spanish: Los resultados son claros; esto es, se repiten en las dos muestras.
pairs.english: The results are clear; that is, they repeat in both samples.

pairs.spanish: La muestra es, por así decirlo, la base del estudio.
pairs.english: The sample is, so to speak, the basis of the study.

pairs.spanish: Cabe pensar que la muestra es demasiado pequeña.
pairs.english: It is reasonable to think that the sample is too small.

pairs.spanish: Hasta cierto punto, la tesis se sostiene.
pairs.english: Up to a point, the thesis holds.

pairs.spanish: Los datos parecen indicar que el efecto es mayor en los grupos pequeños.
pairs.english: The data seem to indicate that the effect is greater in small groups.

pairs.spanish: No conviene generalizar con una muestra tan pequeña; el margen de error es amplio.
pairs.english: It is not advisable to generalise from such a small sample; the margin of error is wide.

pairs.spanish: Pienso que la frase es demasiado larga.
pairs.english: I think the sentence is too long.

pairs.spanish: Me acuerdo de que el editor cambió el título.
pairs.english: I remember that the editor changed the title.

pairs.spanish: Recuerdo que el editor cambió el título.
pairs.english: I remember that the editor changed the title.

pairs.spanish: Estamos seguros de que el informe es correcto.
pairs.english: We are sure the report is correct.

pairs.spanish: Se corrigieron las erratas del primer capítulo.
pairs.english: The misprints in the first chapter were corrected.

pairs.spanish: Se entrevistó a los autores del manual.
pairs.english: The authors of the manual were interviewed.

pairs.spanish: Se aprobó la nueva norma.
pairs.english: The new rule was approved.

pairs.spanish: Se informó a todas las lectoras.
pairs.english: All the readers were informed.

pairs.spanish: Corrigió el texto escuchando música.
pairs.english: She corrected the text listening to music.

pairs.spanish: El avión despegó a las seis y aterrizó a las ocho.
pairs.english: The plane took off at six and landed at eight.

pairs.spanish: Recibimos una carta que contiene tres dudas.
pairs.english: We received a letter containing three queries.

pairs.spanish: Vi a Meg corrigiendo el texto.
pairs.english: I saw Meg correcting the text.

pairs.spanish: La comisión ha recomendado que se publique el dictamen.
pairs.english: The committee has recommended that the formal opinion be published.

pairs.spanish: El director exigió que se entregara el borrador antes del plazo.
pairs.english: The director demanded that the draft be handed in before the deadline.

pairs.spanish: El acta indica que la comisión pidió que se corrigieran las erratas.
pairs.english: The minutes say that the committee asked for the misprints to be corrected.

pairs.spanish: En la sesión de hoy se ha propuesto que se apruebe la enmienda.
pairs.english: At today’s session it has been proposed that the amendment be approved.

pairs.spanish: Hemos freído el pescado.
pairs.english: We have fried the fish.

pairs.spanish: Pedimos pescado frito.
pairs.english: We ordered fried fish.

pairs.spanish: La biblioteca está provista de diccionarios.
pairs.english: The library is supplied with dictionaries.

pairs.spanish: La redacción ha provisto de manuales a los correctores.
pairs.english: The editorial office has supplied the proofreaders with style guides.

pairs.spanish: El calor acelera la fermentación de la mezcla.
pairs.english: Heat speeds up the fermentation of the mixture.

pairs.spanish: Hay que estabilizar la temperatura antes de empezar.
pairs.english: You have to stabilise the temperature before starting.

pairs.spanish: El filtro purifica el agua.
pairs.english: The filter purifies the water.

pairs.spanish: Ensanchamos la ventana para ver mejor.
pairs.english: We widened the window to see better.

pairs.spanish: Los precios bajaron y eso abarató el pan.
pairs.english: Prices fell and that made bread cheaper.

pairs.spanish: Se pesa la harina y se añade la levadura.
pairs.english: The flour is weighed and the yeast is added.

pairs.spanish: Se mide la temperatura del agua.
pairs.english: The temperature of the water is measured.

pairs.spanish: Cuando la masa está mezclada, se deja reposar.
pairs.english: When the dough is mixed, it is left to rest.

pairs.spanish: Se miden las sustancias en un recipiente cerrado.
pairs.english: The substances are measured in a closed container.

pairs.spanish: Los datos no coinciden: tiene que haber un error en la medición.
pairs.english: The data do not match: there must be an error in the measurement.

pairs.spanish: La masa no sube; debe de faltar levadura.
pairs.english: The dough does not rise; yeast must be missing.

pairs.spanish: El aumento puede deberse a la temperatura del laboratorio.
pairs.english: The increase may be due to the temperature of the laboratory.

pairs.spanish: No puede tratarse de un error: se repitió la medición tres veces.
pairs.english: It cannot be an error: the measurement was repeated three times.

pairs.spanish: Tiene que haber sido un error de medición.
pairs.english: It must have been a measurement error.

pairs.spanish: La levadura libera gas; por consiguiente, la masa aumenta de volumen.
pairs.english: The yeast releases gas; consequently, the dough grows in volume.

pairs.spanish: La masa retiene el gas; de ahí que suba en el horno.
pairs.english: The dough holds the gas; hence it rises in the oven.

pairs.spanish: Se calienta el agua con el fin de activar la levadura.
pairs.english: The water is heated in order to activate the yeast.

pairs.spanish: Se pesa la muestra con vistas a repetir el experimento.
pairs.english: The sample is weighed with a view to repeating the experiment.

pairs.spanish: Medidos los ingredientes, se mezclan en el recipiente.
pairs.english: Once the ingredients are measured, they are mixed in the container.

pairs.spanish: Obtenida la mezcla, se deja reposar.
pairs.english: Once the mixture is obtained, it is left to rest.

pairs.spanish: Terminada la cocción, se abre el horno.
pairs.english: Once the baking is finished, the oven is opened.

pairs.spanish: Una vez enfriado el pan, se corta.
pairs.english: Once the bread has cooled, it is cut.

pairs.spanish: Según fuentes, el alcalde habría dimitido.
pairs.english: According to sources, the mayor has reportedly resigned.

pairs.spanish: Al parecer, el incendio habría comenzado en el almacén.
pairs.english: Apparently the fire is reported to have started in the warehouse.

pairs.spanish: Los daños serían importantes, pero aún no hay confirmación.
pairs.english: The damage is reportedly serious, but there is no confirmation yet.

pairs.spanish: El alcalde ha dimitido.
pairs.english: The mayor has resigned. (stated as a fact)

pairs.spanish: El portavoz afirmó que el incendio estaba controlado.
pairs.english: The spokesperson stated that the fire was under control.

pairs.spanish: Las autoridades negaron que hubiera heridos.
pairs.english: The authorities denied that there were any injured.

pairs.spanish: Los bomberos señalaron que habían evacuado el edificio.
pairs.english: The firefighters pointed out that they had evacuated the building.

pairs.spanish: El portavoz anunció que darían a conocer el balance al día siguiente.
pairs.english: The spokesperson announced that they would make the summary public the next day.

pairs.spanish: Dimite el alcalde
pairs.english: The mayor resigns. (the resignation has happened)

pairs.spanish: Alerta por lluvias en la costa
pairs.english: Rain alert on the coast.

pairs.spanish: Arde un almacén en la zona industrial
pairs.english: Warehouse on fire in the industrial zone.

pairs.spanish: Portavoz: «El puente seguirá cerrado»
pairs.english: Spokesperson: "The bridge will stay closed."

pairs.spanish: Dos personas fueron rescatadas por los bomberos.
pairs.english: Two people were rescued by the firefighters.

pairs.spanish: Se detuvo a un sospechoso en la zona.
pairs.english: A suspect was arrested in the area.

pairs.spanish: Se cortó el tráfico en el puente.
pairs.english: Traffic was stopped on the bridge.

pairs.spanish: El puente sigue cortado al tráfico.
pairs.english: The bridge is still closed to traffic.

pairs.spanish: Según los bomberos, el fuego está controlado.
pairs.english: According to the firefighters, the fire is under control.

pairs.spanish: No parece que haya heridos.
pairs.english: It does not seem that there are any injured.

pairs.spanish: Oficialmente, las causas aún no se conocen.
pairs.english: Officially, the causes are not yet known.

pairs.spanish: Hasta el momento, no hay ninguna confirmación.
pairs.english: So far there is no confirmation.

pairs.spanish: Evidentemente, la circulación en el centro histórico no puede seguir así.
pairs.english: Obviously, the traffic in the historic centre cannot go on like this.

pairs.spanish: La zona peatonal es, a todas luces, una buena idea.
pairs.english: The pedestrian zone is, clearly, a good idea.

pairs.spanish: Sin duda, el editorial toma partido.
pairs.english: Without doubt, the editorial takes sides.

pairs.spanish: Francamente, nadie ha explicado por qué esperar.
pairs.english: Frankly, nobody has explained why we should wait.

pairs.spanish: No es que el editorial rechace el diálogo, sino que exige resultados.
pairs.english: It is not that the editorial rejects dialogue, but that it demands results.

pairs.spanish: No es que los vecinos quieran el ruido, sino que nadie les ofrece otra solución.
pairs.english: It is not that the residents want the noise, but that nobody offers them another solution.

pairs.spanish: No es que el comerciante cuestione el plan, sino que pide más tiempo.
pairs.english: It is not that the shopkeeper challenges the plan, but that he asks for more time.

pairs.spanish: No era que el ayuntamiento malinterpretara las quejas, sino que no quería escucharlas.
pairs.english: It was not that the council misread the complaints, but that it did not want to listen to them.

pairs.spanish: Es deplorable que nadie haya respondido a los vecinos.
pairs.english: It is deplorable that nobody has answered the residents.

pairs.spanish: Resulta preocupante que el plan no tenga fecha.
pairs.english: It is worrying that the plan has no date.

pairs.spanish: Es encomiable que el ayuntamiento haya abierto el debate.
pairs.english: It is praiseworthy that the council has opened the debate.

pairs.spanish: Resultaba injustificable que se esperara tanto.
pairs.english: It was unjustifiable that people waited so long.

pairs.spanish: Ciertamente, la objeción es fundada, pero no cambia nuestra postura.
pairs.english: Admittedly, the objection is well founded, but it does not change our position.

pairs.spanish: Si bien el miedo a perder clientes es comprensible, no puede decidir el futuro del centro.
pairs.english: Although the fear of losing customers is understandable, it cannot decide the future of the centre.

pairs.spanish: Aun cuando los comerciantes pierdan algunos clientes, la medida sigue siendo necesaria.
pairs.english: Even if the shopkeepers lose some customers, the measure remains necessary.

pairs.spanish: Por más que pidan más tiempo, la decisión no cambiará.
pairs.english: However much they ask for more time, the decision will not change.

pairs.spanish: ¿Para quién es el centro de la ciudad: para el tráfico o para las personas?
pairs.english: Who is the centre of the city for: traffic or people?

pairs.spanish: Es una medida justa, necesaria y urgente.
pairs.english: It is a measure that is fair, necessary and urgent.

pairs.spanish: Que nadie se esconda tras el pretexto de que el cambio es difícil.
pairs.english: Let nobody hide behind the excuse that the change is difficult.

pairs.spanish: Es hora de decidir.
pairs.english: It is time to decide.

pairs.spanish: Los socios abonarán la cuota en enero.
pairs.english: Members are to pay the fee in January.

pairs.spanish: La junta deberá reunirse una vez al año.
pairs.english: The board must meet once a year.

pairs.spanish: Los socios habrán de cumplir el reglamento.
pairs.english: Members are to comply with the regulation.

pairs.spanish: Los socios no podrán ceder su parcela a nadie.
pairs.english: Members may not hand their plot over to anyone.

pairs.spanish: Quien infringiere esta disposición será amonestado.
pairs.english: Whoever breaks this provision will be warned.

pairs.spanish: Si el socio no cumpliere el plazo, perderá la parcela.
pairs.english: If the member does not meet the deadline, he will lose the plot.

pairs.spanish: Sea lo que fuere, el reglamento sigue vigente.
pairs.english: Be that as it may, the regulation remains in force.

pairs.spanish: El que hubiere pagado la cuota mantendrá su parcela.
pairs.english: Whoever has paid the fee will keep his plot.

pairs.spanish: Todo solicitante que cumpla los requisitos recibirá una parcela.
pairs.english: Every applicant who meets the requirements will receive a plot.

pairs.spanish: Quien desee inscribirse deberá presentar una solicitud.
pairs.english: Whoever wishes to register must submit an application.

pairs.spanish: Cualquier persona que incumpla el reglamento perderá su plaza.
pairs.english: Any person who breaches the regulation will lose their place.

pairs.spanish: Los solicitantes que ya se inscribieron esperan una respuesta.
pairs.english: The applicants who have already registered are waiting for an answer.

pairs.spanish: En caso de que haya dudas, la junta decidirá.
pairs.english: In the event of doubt, the board will decide.

pairs.spanish: La baja será efectiva previo aviso por escrito.
pairs.english: The withdrawal takes effect after notice in writing.

pairs.spanish: Los socios podrán pedir una prórroga siempre y cuando lo notifiquen a tiempo.
pairs.english: Members may ask for an extension as long as they give notice in time.

pairs.spanish: El plazo no vencerá salvo que la junta lo decida.
pairs.english: The deadline will not expire unless the board decides so.

pairs.spanish: Queda prohibido el uso de las herramientas comunes sin permiso.
pairs.english: The use of the shared tools without permission is prohibited.

pairs.spanish: Se procederá a la expulsión del socio que incumpla el reglamento.
pairs.english: The member who breaches the regulation will be expelled.

pairs.spanish: El impago de la cuota será motivo de amonestación.
pairs.english: Non-payment of the fee will be grounds for a warning.

pairs.spanish: El incumplimiento del reglamento podrá dar lugar a una sanción.
pairs.english: Breach of the regulation may lead to a penalty.

pairs.spanish: La resolución, según la cual el plazo vence el lunes, ya está publicada.
pairs.english: The resolution, according to which the deadline expires on Monday, is already published.

pairs.spanish: El organismo a través del cual se tramita la licencia atiende en la ventanilla.
pairs.english: The body through which the licence is processed serves people at the counter.

pairs.spanish: Las licencias, las cuales otorga el departamento, vencen cada año.
pairs.english: The licences, which the department grants, expire every year.

pairs.spanish: No se presentó el expediente, lo cual retrasó el trámite.
pairs.english: The file was not submitted, which delayed the procedure.

pairs.spanish: El usuario cuya solicitud fue denegada puede presentar un recurso.
pairs.english: The user whose application was denied may lodge an appeal.

pairs.spanish: El trámite cuyo plazo vence el lunes es gratuito.
pairs.english: The procedure whose deadline expires on Monday is free.

pairs.spanish: Los usuarios cuyas reclamaciones son aceptadas reciben una respuesta.
pairs.english: The users whose complaints are accepted receive an answer.

pairs.spanish: La oficina cuyo horario cambió atiende por la tarde.
pairs.english: The office whose hours changed serves people in the afternoon.

pairs.spanish: Me dirijo a ustedes para solicitar una cita previa.
pairs.english: I am writing to you to request an appointment.

pairs.spanish: Quería solicitar información sobre la licencia.
pairs.english: I would like to request information about the licence.

pairs.spanish: Adjunto el justificante de la tasa.
pairs.english: I enclose the proof of payment of the fee.

pairs.spanish: Les agradezco de antemano su atención.
pairs.english: I thank you in advance for your attention.

pairs.spanish: Se ruega a los usuarios disculpar la demora.
pairs.english: Users are kindly asked to excuse the delay.

pairs.spanish: Se atiende a los usuarios en el mostrador.
pairs.english: Users are attended to at the counter.

pairs.spanish: Se sellarán los documentos en la ventanilla.
pairs.english: The documents will be stamped at the counter.

pairs.spanish: Se tramitarán las solicitudes por orden de llegada.
pairs.english: Applications will be processed in order of arrival.

pairs.spanish: Se revisó el expediente y se otorgó la licencia.
pairs.english: The file was reviewed and the licence was granted.

pairs.spanish: Se pagará la tasa en línea.
pairs.english: The fee will be paid online.

pairs.spanish: El nuevo trámite ha agilizado el procedimiento.
pairs.english: The new procedure has speeded up the process.

pairs.spanish: La jerga hace más lenta la burocracia.
pairs.english: Jargon slows bureaucracy down.

pairs.spanish: La gente opina que el transporte público ha mejorado.
pairs.english: People think that public transport has improved.

pairs.spanish: La mayoría de los encuestados respondió que prefiere vivir en la ciudad.
pairs.english: Most respondents answered that they prefer to live in the city.

pairs.spanish: La mitad de los alumnos aprobaron el examen en junio.
pairs.english: Half of the students passed the exam in June.

pairs.spanish: El 40 % de los hogares cuenta con acceso a internet.
pairs.english: Forty per cent of households have internet access.

pairs.spanish: La población de la región va envejeciendo progresivamente.
pairs.english: The region's population is gradually ageing.

pairs.spanish: A medida que bajaba la natalidad, los pueblos iban perdiendo habitantes.
pairs.english: As the birth rate fell, the villages were gradually losing inhabitants.

pairs.spanish: El número de hogares de una sola persona se fue duplicando en veinte años.
pairs.english: The number of single-person households doubled gradually over twenty years.

pairs.spanish: La tendencia va cambiando poco a poco desde el último repunte.
pairs.english: The trend has been changing little by little since the last uptick.

pairs.spanish: En la última década, la tasa de envejecimiento llegó a duplicarse.
pairs.english: In the last decade, the ageing rate even doubled.

pairs.spanish: La natalidad mostró un ligero repunte, pero no llegó a superar el nivel anterior.
pairs.english: The birth rate showed a slight uptick, but did not manage to exceed the previous level.

pairs.spanish: El número de mayores de sesenta y cinco años ha llegado a alcanzar cifras históricas.
pairs.english: The number of people over sixty-five has reached historic figures.

pairs.spanish: La población rural cayó más de lo que preveía el estudio.
pairs.english: The rural population fell more than the study forecast.

pairs.spanish: Se marcharon más personas de las que habían llegado el año anterior.
pairs.english: More people left than had arrived the year before.

pairs.spanish: La ciudad absorbió menos hogares de los que indicaba la proyección.
pairs.english: The city absorbed fewer households than the projection indicated.

pairs.spanish: Este municipio perdió más habitantes que la localidad vecina.
pairs.english: This municipality lost more inhabitants than the neighbouring town.

pairs.spanish: El informe analizó más de cien localidades del interior.
pairs.english: The report analysed more than a hundred inland towns.

pairs.spanish: El porcentaje de mayores superó el treinta por ciento en 2024.
pairs.english: The percentage of older people exceeded thirty per cent in 2024.

pairs.spanish: Alrededor de un tercio de los jóvenes se trasladó a centros urbanos.
pairs.english: Around a third of young people moved to urban centres.

pairs.spanish: El índice de natalidad se situó en torno a los nueve nacimientos por cada mil habitantes.
pairs.english: The birth rate index stood at around nine births per thousand inhabitants.

pairs.spanish: El promedio anual ronda los doce mil desplazamientos.
pairs.english: The annual average is around twelve thousand moves.

pairs.spanish: El censo refleja una fuerte correlación, pero no demuestra causalidad.
pairs.english: The census reflects a strong correlation, but does not prove causation.

pairs.spanish: Los resultados apuntan a un cambio lento en la estructura familiar.
pairs.english: The results point to a slow change in family structure.

pairs.spanish: Estas cifras no permiten concluir que la emigración sea el único factor.
pairs.english: These figures do not allow us to conclude that emigration is the only factor.

pairs.spanish: Conviene leer con prudencia las variaciones de una muestra pequeña.
pairs.english: It is advisable to read the variations of a small sample with caution.

pairs.spanish: La caída de la natalidad podría deberse a varios factores económicos.
pairs.english: The drop in the birth rate could be due to several economic factors.

pairs.spanish: Esta variación puede reflejar un sesgo en la selección de la muestra.
pairs.english: This variation may reflect a bias in the selection of the sample.

pairs.spanish: La diferencia entre municipios debe de haber aumentado en los últimos años.
pairs.english: The difference between municipalities must have grown in recent years.

pairs.spanish: El consumo cayó debido al encarecimiento del crédito.
pairs.english: Consumption fell because of the rising cost of credit.

pairs.spanish: A raíz de la crisis en la cadena de suministro, varios productos se encarecieron.
pairs.english: Following the crisis in the supply chain, several products became more expensive.

pairs.spanish: Como consecuencia de la inflación, las familias perdieron poder adquisitivo.
pairs.english: As a consequence of inflation, households lost purchasing power.

pairs.spanish: Dado que las tasas de interés siguen altas, el crédito resulta más caro.
pairs.english: Given that interest rates remain high, credit is more expensive.

pairs.spanish: De mantenerse esta tendencia, la desaceleración durará varios meses.
pairs.english: If this trend continues, the slowdown will last several months.

pairs.spanish: De no cambiar la política monetaria, el estancamiento podría prolongarse.
pairs.english: If monetary policy does not change, stagnation could drag on.

pairs.spanish: De haber pedido el préstamo antes, la empresa pagaría menos intereses.
pairs.english: Had the company taken out the loan earlier, it would be paying less interest.

pairs.spanish: Frenando el gasto público, el gobierno evitaría una recesión mayor.
pairs.english: By curbing public spending, the government would avoid a deeper recession.

pairs.spanish: Si el banco central hubiera actuado antes, hoy las hipotecas serían más asequibles.
pairs.english: If the central bank had acted earlier, mortgages would be more affordable today.

pairs.spanish: Si no hubiéramos aumentado los impuestos el año pasado, ahora el déficit sería mayor.
pairs.english: If we had not raised taxes last year, the deficit would be larger now.

pairs.spanish: Si la empresa hubiera protegido sus ingresos, hoy contaría con suficiente liquidez.
pairs.english: If the company had protected its revenue, it would have enough liquidity today.

pairs.spanish: Si se hubiera aplicado el ajuste a tiempo, la presión sobre los hogares se aliviaría ahora.
pairs.english: If the adjustment had been applied in time, the pressure on households would ease now.

pairs.spanish: Sea cual sea la medida que se tome, llevará tiempo estimular el consumo.
pairs.english: Whatever measure is taken, it will take time to stimulate consumption.

pairs.spanish: Sean cuales sean las cifras de este trimestre, el banco pondrá en marcha el plan.
pairs.english: Whatever this quarter's figures may be, the bank will launch the plan.

pairs.spanish: El equipo económico llevará a cabo la reforma pase lo que pase.
pairs.english: The economic team will carry out the reform whatever happens.

pairs.spanish: Mantener las tasas bajas cueste lo que cueste puede dar lugar a más inflación.
pairs.english: Keeping rates low at any cost can give rise to higher inflation.

pairs.spanish: Tras meses de debate, el comité acabó por aprobar el ajuste.
pairs.english: After months of debate, the committee ended up approving the adjustment.

pairs.spanish: El deterioro del crédito terminó por enfriar la demanda interna.
pairs.english: The deterioration of credit ended up cooling domestic demand.

pairs.spanish: Un arancel demasiado alto acaba por perjudicar al propio consumidor.
pairs.english: An overly high tariff ends up harming the consumer as well.

pairs.spanish: En una década, la región pasó a ser el principal exportador del sector.
pairs.english: Within a decade, the region went on to become the sector's main exporter.

pairs.spanish: Al caer el consumo interno, las empresas pasaron a buscar mercados externos.
pairs.english: When domestic consumption fell, companies shifted to seeking external markets.

pairs.spanish: Tras la reforma, la producción local pasó a cubrir casi toda la demanda.
pairs.english: After the reform, local production went on to cover almost all demand.

pairs.spanish: La empresa procura mantener una jornada laboral equilibrada.
pairs.english: The company tries to maintain a balanced working day.

pairs.spanish: Los representantes exigen que la dirección respete la negociación colectiva.
pairs.english: The representatives demand that management respect collective bargaining.

pairs.spanish: Conviene calcular bien la indemnización antes de firmar el acuerdo.
pairs.english: It is advisable to calculate the severance pay carefully before signing the agreement.

pairs.spanish: Conviene que el departamento legal revise las condiciones del despido.
pairs.english: It is advisable that the legal department review the terms of the dismissal.

pairs.spanish: Cuanto mayor es la estabilidad laboral, menor suele ser la rotación de personal.
pairs.english: The greater job stability is, the lower staff turnover tends to be.

pairs.spanish: Cuantas más horas se dedican a capacitar al equipo, mejores son los resultados.
pairs.english: The more hours are devoted to training the team, the better the results are.

pairs.spanish: A medida que avanza la automatización, se valoran nuevas competencias en toda trayectoria.
pairs.english: As automation advances, new skills are valued across any career path.

pairs.spanish: Cuanto menos clara es la trayectoria profesional, más rápido buscan otro empleo.
pairs.english: The less clear the career path is, the faster they look for another job.

pairs.spanish: La modalidad híbrida no solo atrae talento, sino que también reduce la rotación.
pairs.english: The hybrid model not only attracts talent, but also reduces turnover.

pairs.spanish: El cambio no solo afecta al horario, sino también a la remuneración variable.
pairs.english: The change affects not only the schedule, but also variable pay.

pairs.spanish: Tanto el teletrabajo como la flexibilidad horaria exigen reglas claras para evitar la sobrecarga.
pairs.english: Both remote work and flexible hours require clear rules to avoid overload.

pairs.spanish: Una buena evaluación no solo mide el desempeño, sino que también orienta la capacitación.
pairs.english: A good appraisal not only measures performance, but also guides training.

pairs.spanish: En muchas consultoras pagan una parte en nómina y otra por objetivos.
pairs.english: In many consultancies they pay one part on the payroll and another by targets.

pairs.spanish: A veces despiden personal durante una crisis y luego recurren a la subcontratación.
pairs.english: Sometimes they lay off staff during a crisis and then resort to outsourcing.

pairs.spanish: Cuando uno trabaja por cuenta propia, organiza su horario pero cubre sus prestaciones.
pairs.english: When you work self-employed, you organise your schedule but cover your own benefits.

pairs.spanish: Con los años de antigüedad, una aprende a negociar mejor su salario.
pairs.english: With years of seniority, you (a woman speaking) learn to negotiate your salary better.

pairs.spanish: Los perfiles técnicos encuentran empleo rápido; los jóvenes sin experiencia, en cambio, enfrentan una inserción laboral lenta.
pairs.english: Technical profiles find work quickly; young people without experience, on the other hand, face slow labour-market entry.

pairs.spanish: La reestructuración no cerró la planta; por el contrario, permitió modernizar las líneas de producción.
pairs.english: The restructuring did not close the plant; on the contrary, it made it possible to modernise the production lines.

pairs.spanish: El salario mínimo mejoró el ingreso básico; no obstante, la brecha salarial sigue siendo un reto.
pairs.english: The minimum wage improved basic income; nevertheless, the pay gap remains a challenge.

pairs.spanish: El contrato indefinido da seguridad. Ahora bien, las empresas también necesitan capacidad de adaptación.
pairs.english: A permanent contract provides security. That said, companies also need room to adapt.

pairs.spanish: Ese enfoque lo defendió el invitado al comienzo del debate.
pairs.english: That approach was defended by the guest at the start of the debate.

pairs.spanish: La réplica la guardo para mi siguiente turno de palabra.
pairs.english: I am saving the rebuttal for my next turn to speak.

pairs.spanish: A los dos invitados les pidió el moderador que respetaran el tiempo.
pairs.english: The moderator asked both guests to respect the time.

pairs.spanish: Eso no lo afirmé en mi primera intervención.
pairs.english: I did not claim that in my first contribution.

pairs.spanish: Es cierto que el estudio aporta datos útiles; sin embargo, la conclusión cae en una falacia.
pairs.english: It is true that the study provides useful data; however, the conclusion falls into a fallacy.

pairs.spanish: Si bien existe consenso sobre el problema, las soluciones siguen generando desacuerdo.
pairs.english: Although there is consensus on the problem, the solutions still generate disagreement.

pairs.spanish: Es cierto que la concesión mejora el diálogo; no obstante, conviene revisar los detalles.
pairs.english: It is true that the concession improves the dialogue; nevertheless, it is advisable to review the details.

pairs.spanish: Si bien su alusión fue breve, provocó una contrarréplica muy contundente.
pairs.english: Although his allusion was brief, it triggered a very forceful counter-rebuttal.

pairs.spanish: Disculpe que interrumpa, pero quería añadir una precisión sobre los datos.
pairs.english: Excuse me for interrupting, but I wanted to add a clarification on the figures.

pairs.spanish: Si me permite tomar la palabra, deseo retomar el tema anterior.
pairs.english: If you allow me to take the floor, I wish to return to the previous topic.

pairs.spanish: El moderador pidió brevedad antes de ceder la palabra a la invitada.
pairs.english: The moderator asked for brevity before yielding the floor to the guest.

pairs.spanish: Quería pedir la palabra para responder a la última alusión.
pairs.english: I wanted to ask for the floor to respond to the latest allusion.

pairs.spanish: Lo que usted sostiene, es decir, que el plan no cuesta nada, ignora los gastos ocultos.
pairs.english: What you claim, that is, that the plan costs nothing, ignores the hidden expenses.

pairs.spanish: No quiero tergiversar su postura; en otras palabras, ¿propone limitar el uso del celular solo en clase?
pairs.english: I do not want to distort your position; in other words, are you proposing to limit phone use only in class?

pairs.spanish: El ponente afirmó el mes pasado que aquel día presentaría el informe allí.
pairs.english: The speaker stated last month that he would present the report there that day.

pairs.spanish: Conviene razonar con datos y ceñirse al tema sin desviar la conversación hacia asuntos personales.
pairs.english: It is advisable to reason with data and stick to the topic without straying onto personal matters.

pairs.spanish: La síntesis final recogió ambas posturas de tal manera que facilitó el cierre del foro.
pairs.english: The final summary captured both positions in such a way that it facilitated the closing of the forum.

pairs.spanish: El desacuerdo creció hasta el punto de que el moderador tuvo que pedir brevedad.
pairs.english: The disagreement grew to the point that the moderator had to ask for brevity.

pairs.spanish: Conviene estructurar la ponencia de tal manera que el público siga cada paso sin esfuerzo.
pairs.english: It is advisable to structure the presentation in such a way that the audience follows each step effortlessly.

pairs.spanish: Respondió con tanta contundencia que nadie pidió una contrarréplica.
pairs.english: She replied with such forcefulness that nobody asked for a counter-rebuttal.

pairs.spanish: La directora dice que el cambio es explícito, pero también dice que revisemos el informe.
pairs.english: The director says the change is explicit, and she also tells us to review the report.

pairs.spanish: Siento que el mensaje implícito genera confusión; siento que no podamos aclararlo hoy.
pairs.english: I sense that the implicit message causes confusion; I am sorry that we cannot clarify it today.

pairs.spanish: Comprendo que la interpretación depende del contexto, y comprendo que te preocupes.
pairs.english: I realise that the interpretation depends on context, and I understand your being worried.

pairs.spanish: Supongo que aceptaron la suposición, aunque eso supone que cambiemos el plan.
pairs.english: I assume they accepted the assumption, although that entails our changing the plan.

pairs.spanish: Sospecho que la ambigüedad del comunicado responde a una estrategia consciente.
pairs.english: I suspect that the ambiguity of the statement reflects a deliberate strategy.

pairs.spanish: Dudo que el público infiera esa conclusión sin una explicación más clara.
pairs.english: I doubt that the audience will infer that conclusion without a clearer explanation.

pairs.spanish: No es seguro que el contrato presuponga un acuerdo previo entre las partes.
pairs.english: It is not certain that the contract presupposes a prior agreement between the parties.

pairs.spanish: De sus palabras deduzco que el mensaje era deliberadamente ambiguo.
pairs.english: From his words I deduce that the message was deliberately ambiguous.

pairs.spanish: La periodista preguntó si el portavoz había insinuado una dimisión.
pairs.english: The journalist asked whether the spokesperson had hinted at a resignation.

pairs.spanish: Nadie entendió a qué aludía el director con aquella insinuación tan breve.
pairs.english: Nobody understood what the director was alluding to with that brief hint.

pairs.spanish: El comentario tenía un doble sentido que cambió toda la lectura del mensaje.
pairs.english: The remark had a double meaning that changed the whole reading of the message.

pairs.spanish: Me preguntó cómo debía interpretar el subtexto de la carta.
pairs.english: She asked me how she should interpret the subtext of the letter.

pairs.spanish: En apariencia, la nota es neutral; en el fondo, tiene una connotación crítica muy sutil.
pairs.english: On the surface, the note is neutral; underneath, it has a very subtle critical connotation.

pairs.spanish: Aparentemente, todos estuvieron de acuerdo, pero faltó franqueza en la reunión.
pairs.english: Apparently, everyone agreed, but there was a lack of candour in the meeting.

pairs.spanish: Francamente, hay que leer entre líneas para captar la intención real de ese correo.
pairs.english: Frankly, you have to read between the lines to grasp the real intention of that email.

pairs.spanish: Precisamente esa palabra sutil explica por qué cambió el tono del mensaje.
pairs.english: Precisely that subtle word explains why the tone of the message changed.

pairs.spanish: Leyó el mensaje como si el sarcasmo fuera una afirmación literal.
pairs.english: He read the message as if the sarcasm were a literal statement.

pairs.spanish: Actuó como si no hubiera captado el guiño ni el sobreentendido de la frase.
pairs.english: She acted as if she had not caught the wink or the unspoken meaning of the sentence.

pairs.spanish: Contestó con tanta frialdad como si hubiera ocurrido un grave equívoco.
pairs.english: He replied as coldly as if a serious misunderstanding had occurred.

pairs.spanish: Habla de la ironía como si siempre resultara evidente por escrito.
pairs.english: She speaks about irony as if it were always obvious in writing.

pairs.spanish: La deontología establece que el médico debe proteger la confidencialidad del paciente.
pairs.english: Professional ethics establishes that the doctor must protect the patient's confidentiality.

pairs.spanish: Para aprobar el estudio, el hospital tiene que presentar toda la documentación ante el comité de ética.
pairs.english: To approve the study, the hospital has to submit all documentation to the ethics committee.

pairs.spanish: La clínica debería haber respetado la objeción de conciencia sin retrasar la atención.
pairs.english: The clinic should have respected conscientious objection without delaying care.

pairs.spanish: En bioética, toda norma ha de equilibrar los derechos individuales con el bien común.
pairs.english: In bioethics, every rule must balance individual rights with the common good.

pairs.spanish: Antes de que se inicie el ensayo clínico, cada participante debe firmar el consentimiento informado.
pairs.english: Before the clinical trial begins, each participant must sign the informed consent.

pairs.spanish: Después de que el comité haya evaluado los resultados, se podrá autorizar el fármaco.
pairs.english: After the committee has evaluated the results, the drug can be authorised.

pairs.spanish: Después de que el laboratorio entregó los análisis, la especialista diagnosticó el problema con precisión.
pairs.english: After the laboratory delivered the tests, the specialist diagnosed the problem accurately.

pairs.spanish: Después de haber confirmado el diagnóstico, el equipo decidió prescribir un tratamiento más suave.
pairs.english: After confirming the diagnosis, the team decided to prescribe a milder treatment.

pairs.spanish: A pesar de que el fármaco mostró una alta eficacia, algunos participantes sufrieron efectos secundarios.
pairs.english: Although the drug showed high efficacy, some participants suffered side effects.

pairs.spanish: Pese a que existan reparos éticos sobre la terapia génica, el debate científico sigue abierto.
pairs.english: Even though ethical objections to gene therapy may exist, the scientific debate remains open.

pairs.spanish: Pese a haber superado las pruebas frente al placebo, el tratamiento requiere seguimiento prolongado.
pairs.english: Despite having passed the tests against the placebo, the treatment requires extended monitoring.

pairs.spanish: A pesar de los avances en la prevención, la investigación biomédica sigue enfrentando dilemas complejos.
pairs.english: Despite advances in prevention, biomedical research continues to face complex dilemmas.

pairs.spanish: Cualesquiera que sean las patologías del paciente, la equidad sanitaria exige un trato justo.
pairs.english: Whatever the patient's medical conditions may be, health equity demands fair treatment.

pairs.spanish: Cualquiera que fuera el diagnóstico, el hospital garantizó el acceso a los cuidados paliativos.
pairs.english: Whatever the diagnosis was, the hospital guaranteed access to palliative care.

pairs.spanish: Quienquiera que se ofrezca como donante debe recibir información completa sobre la operación.
pairs.english: Whoever volunteers as a donor must receive complete information about the operation.

pairs.spanish: Un trasplante no es una intervención quirúrgica cualquiera; exige una evaluación ética rigurosa.
pairs.english: A transplant is not just any surgical intervention; it demands a rigorous ethical evaluation.

pairs.spanish: Si el laboratorio hubiera actuado con transparencia, se habría evitado la acusación de negligencia.
pairs.english: If the laboratory had acted with transparency, the accusation of negligence would have been avoided.

pairs.spanish: Si se hubiese fortalecido la campaña de inmunización, la salud pública habría sufrido menos presión.
pairs.english: If the immunisation campaign had been strengthened, public health would have suffered less pressure.

pairs.spanish: Si el comité hubiese aplicado el principio de beneficencia, hoy no existiría este dilema ético.
pairs.english: If the committee had applied the principle of beneficence, this ethical dilemma would not exist today.

pairs.spanish: Si hubieran explicado los riesgos desde el inicio, los pacientes habrían confiado en el equipo.
pairs.english: If they had explained the risks from the beginning, the patients would have trusted the team.

pairs.spanish: Para cuando entre en vigor la nueva norma, el sector industrial habrá mejorado su eficiencia energética.
pairs.english: By the time the new rule enters into force, the industrial sector will have improved its energy efficiency.

pairs.spanish: Para finales de la década se habrán reducido las emisiones gracias a la electrificación del transporte.
pairs.english: By the end of the decade, emissions will have been reduced thanks to the electrification of transport.

pairs.spanish: El retraso en las obras de la red eléctrica habrá complicado el camino hacia la neutralidad climática.
pairs.english: The delay in grid works has probably complicated the path toward climate neutrality.

pairs.spanish: Si mantenemos este ritmo, en diez años habremos consolidado la transición energética.
pairs.english: If we keep this pace, in ten years we will have consolidated the energy transition.

pairs.spanish: Si se aprobara un impuesto al carbono, las industrias acelerarían la mitigación de sus emisiones.
pairs.english: If a carbon tax were approved, industries would accelerate the mitigation of their emissions.

pairs.spanish: Si las ciudades incentivaran la adaptación climática, reducirían los daños ante fenómenos extremos.
pairs.english: If cities incentivised climate adaptation, they would reduce damage from extreme weather events.

pairs.spanish: Si se redujesen las cuotas de emisión cada año, disminuiría la dependencia de los combustibles fósiles.
pairs.english: If emissions quotas were reduced every year, dependence on fossil fuels would decrease.

pairs.spanish: Si existiera un fondo estable, los municipios podrían financiar proyectos de adaptación climática.
pairs.english: If a stable fund existed, municipalities could finance climate-adaptation projects.

pairs.spanish: Se deben controlar los vertidos químicos para garantizar la conservación del humedal.
pairs.english: Chemical discharges must be controlled to guarantee the conservation of the wetland.

pairs.spanish: En los últimos años se han impulsado programas de restauración ecológica y reciclaje urbano.
pairs.english: In recent years, ecological-restoration and urban-recycling programmes have been promoted.

pairs.spanish: Se prohíbe la tala comercial en zonas protegidas y se prohíben también los vertidos sin tratamiento.
pairs.english: Commercial logging is prohibited in protected areas, and untreated discharges are also prohibited.

pairs.spanish: Se recomienda separar los materiales para facilitar el reciclaje municipal.
pairs.english: Separating materials is recommended to facilitate municipal recycling.

pairs.spanish: El informe advierte que la escasez hídrica amenaza la estabilidad de todo el ecosistema.
pairs.english: The report warns that water scarcity threatens the stability of the entire ecosystem.

pairs.spanish: De acuerdo con los datos regionales, el calentamiento global incrementa la frecuencia de los incendios forestales.
pairs.english: According to regional data, global warming increases the frequency of forest fires.

pairs.spanish: Según concluye el estudio ambiental, reducir la huella ecológica exige cambios en el transporte.
pairs.english: As the environmental study concludes, reducing the ecological footprint requires changes in transport.

pairs.spanish: La evaluación señala que la desertificación avanza con mayor rapidez en zonas sin vegetación.
pairs.english: The assessment points out that desertification advances more rapidly in areas without vegetation.

pairs.spanish: Lo prioritario del acuerdo climático es garantizar una fiscalización independiente y constante.
pairs.english: The priority of the climate agreement is to guarantee independent and constant oversight.

pairs.spanish: Lo acordado por los municipios impulsa la economía circular y la sostenibilidad a largo plazo.
pairs.english: What was agreed by the municipalities promotes the circular economy and long-term sustainability.

pairs.spanish: Lo más urgente en las zonas secas son las inversiones en gestión hídrica y resiliencia.
pairs.english: The most urgent thing in dry areas is investment in water management and resilience.

pairs.spanish: Lo previsto en el plan oficial busca equilibrar el crecimiento económico con la sostenibilidad.
pairs.english: What is planned in the official plan seeks to balance economic growth with sustainability.

pairs.spanish: Considero que la inteligencia artificial exige criterios públicos para reducir la opacidad.
pairs.english: I consider that artificial intelligence requires public criteria to reduce opacity.

pairs.spanish: No considero que el algoritmo haya alcanzado una verdadera neutralidad en sus decisiones.
pairs.english: I do not consider that the algorithm has achieved genuine neutrality in its decisions.

pairs.spanish: Al principio nadie creía que un modelo predictivo pudiera reproducir el sesgo algorítmico.
pairs.english: At first nobody believed that a predictive model could reproduce algorithmic bias.

pairs.spanish: ¿Crees que el nuevo sistema mejora la transparencia o solo esconde la opacidad?
pairs.english: Do you think the new system improves transparency or only hides opacity?

pairs.spanish: A raíz de la filtración de datos, la empresa reforzó el cifrado de todas las cuentas.
pairs.english: In the wake of the data breach, the company strengthened encryption for all accounts.

pairs.spanish: En virtud de la normativa de protección de datos, se limitó el reconocimiento facial en espacios públicos.
pairs.english: Under data-protection regulations, facial recognition in public spaces was limited.

pairs.spanish: Frente a la vigilancia masiva, muchos expertos defienden límites estrictos para los datos biométricos.
pairs.english: In the face of mass surveillance, many experts defend strict limits on biometric data.

pairs.spanish: Con respecto a la protección de datos, las plataformas deben explicar cómo usan el cifrado.
pairs.english: With regard to data protection, platforms must explain how they use encryption.

pairs.spanish: No es el contenido sintético lo que destruye la confianza, sino la ausencia de verificación.
pairs.english: It is not synthetic content that destroys trust, but the absence of verification.

pairs.spanish: Es en la cámara de eco donde la desinformación circula con mayor rapidez.
pairs.english: It is in the echo chamber that disinformation circulates most rapidly.

pairs.spanish: La moderación de contenidos es lo que exige criterios públicos y transparentes.
pairs.english: Content moderation is what demands public and transparent criteria.

pairs.spanish: Son las redes cerradas las que dificultan comprobar la veracidad de una noticia.
pairs.english: It is closed networks that make it difficult to verify the truthfulness of a news item.

pairs.spanish: El marco regulatorio exige que se audite cada modelo antes de su uso público.
pairs.english: The regulatory framework requires that every model be audited before public use.

pairs.spanish: La autoridad de control ordenó que se garantizara la supervisión humana en decisiones sensibles.
pairs.english: The oversight authority ordered that human oversight be guaranteed in sensitive decisions.

pairs.spanish: El informe técnico recomendó que se ampliaran las medidas de ciberseguridad y auditoría algorítmica.
pairs.english: The technical report recommended that cybersecurity and algorithmic-auditing measures be expanded.

pairs.spanish: La regulación tecnológica pide que las empresas informen con claridad sobre sus sistemas.
pairs.english: Tech regulation asks that companies report clearly on their systems.

pairs.spanish: No debemos dar por sentado que el código abierto elimine por sí solo la discriminación algorítmica.
pairs.english: We must not take for granted that open source eliminates algorithmic discrimination on its own.

pairs.spanish: Algunos analistas dan por hecho que la responsabilidad algorítmica depende únicamente de las empresas.
pairs.english: Some analysts take for granted that algorithmic accountability depends solely on companies.

pairs.spanish: El tribunal no dio por cerradas las cuestiones sobre el derecho al olvido y la propiedad intelectual.
pairs.english: The court did not consider the questions about the right to be forgotten and intellectual property closed.

pairs.spanish: En ética tecnológica, nunca conviene dar por resuelta una disputa sin escuchar a los afectados.
pairs.english: In tech ethics, it is never advisable to treat a dispute as settled without listening to those affected.

pairs.spanish: Antes el casco histórico albergaba pequeños talleres, pero en la última década el alquiler vacacional ha transformado el tejido vecinal.
pairs.english: Before, the historic centre housed small workshops, but in the last decade holiday rentals have transformed the neighbourhood fabric.

pairs.spanish: Durante años las familias encontraban vivienda asequible en el centro, mientras que ahora la gentrificación ha reducido las opciones.
pairs.english: For years families found affordable housing in the centre, whereas now gentrification has reduced the options.

pairs.spanish: El barrio mantenía una densidad urbana equilibrada; sin embargo, el nuevo modelo de urbanismo ha cambiado el uso de las calles.
pairs.english: The neighbourhood maintained a balanced urban density; however, the new model of urban planning has changed how the streets are used.

pairs.spanish: Antes los vecinos se conocían en la plaza, pero el aumento de los alquileres ha debilitado la vida comunitaria.
pairs.english: Before, neighbours knew one another in the square, but rising rents have weakened community life.

pairs.spanish: Con la especulación inmobiliaria, el alquiler en el área metropolitana se ha vuelto inaccesible para muchos jóvenes.
pairs.english: With property speculation, rent in the metropolitan area has become inaccessible for many young people.

pairs.spanish: Tras varios desalojos, dos calles enteras se quedaron despobladas durante meses.
pairs.english: After several evictions, two whole streets were left depopulated for months.

pairs.spanish: En quince años, el viejo barrio portuario se convirtió en un centro comercial de alto precio.
pairs.english: In fifteen years, the old port district turned into a high-priced commercial centre.

pairs.spanish: Para muchos inquilinos, renovar el contrato en el centro se ha hecho insostenible.
pairs.english: For many tenants, renewing the lease in the centre has become unsustainable.

pairs.spanish: El plan urbanístico por el que apuesta el municipio prioriza la vivienda social.
pairs.english: The urban plan that the municipality is backing prioritises social housing.

pairs.spanish: La zonificación en la que se basa el proyecto busca frenar la segregación espacial.
pairs.english: The zoning on which the project is based seeks to curb spatial segregation.

pairs.spanish: Son problemas de habitabilidad a los que responde la renovación urbana.
pairs.english: These are habitability problems to which urban renewal responds.

pairs.spanish: Se trata de un parque de viviendas del que dependen miles de inquilinos.
pairs.english: It is a housing stock on which thousands of tenants depend.

pairs.spanish: No se trata solo de edificar nuevas torres, sino de rehabilitar los edificios vacíos.
pairs.english: It is not only a matter of building new towers, but of renovating empty buildings.

pairs.spanish: La expansión urbana no solo aleja a las familias del centro, sino que además complica la movilidad urbana.
pairs.english: Urban sprawl not only pushes families away from the centre, but also complicates urban mobility.

pairs.spanish: La ciudad compacta no elimina el crecimiento, sino que busca garantizar una vivienda digna cerca de los servicios.
pairs.english: The compact city does not eliminate growth, but rather seeks to guarantee decent housing near services.

pairs.spanish: La rehabilitación requiere mayor inversión inicial, pero evita dañar el tejido vecinal.
pairs.english: Renovation requires higher initial investment, but avoids harming the neighbourhood fabric.

pairs.spanish: Apenas se anunció la renovación del puerto, se disparó el valor del suelo urbano.
pairs.english: As soon as the port renewal was announced, the value of urban land shot up.

pairs.spanish: Al cabo de una década, la burbuja inmobiliaria había encarecido toda la zona residencial.
pairs.english: After a decade, the housing bubble had driven up prices across the entire residential area.

pairs.spanish: Conforme crecía la plusvalía de los edificios, resultaba menos asequible vivir cerca del centro.
pairs.english: As the capital gain on buildings grew, living near the centre became less affordable.

pairs.spanish: En cuanto se apruebe el alquiler regulado, muchas familias podrán planificar a largo plazo.
pairs.english: As soon as regulated rent is approved, many families will be able to plan for the long term.

pairs.spanish: Se comió el pastel entero sin dejar ni un bocado.
pairs.english: He ate the whole cake without leaving a single bite.

pairs.spanish: Tenía tanta sed que se bebió el vaso de agua de un trago.
pairs.english: She was so thirsty that she drank the glass of water in one gulp.

pairs.spanish: Me leí la novela entera de una sentada el domingo pasado.
pairs.english: I read the whole novel in one sitting last Sunday.

pairs.spanish: Se sabe de memoria todos los pasos de la receta.
pairs.english: She knows all the steps of the recipe by heart.

pairs.spanish: Por un despiste, se me quemó la salsa mientras atendía la puerta.
pairs.english: Through a lapse of attention, I accidentally burned the sauce while answering the door.

pairs.spanish: Se le derramó el caldo caliente sobre el mantel limpio.
pairs.english: He accidentally spilled the hot broth onto the clean tablecloth.

pairs.spanish: Se nos olvidaron las llaves dentro del apartamento al salir con prisa.
pairs.english: We accidentally left the keys inside the apartment when leaving in a hurry.

pairs.spanish: Se les cayó la bandeja justo antes de llegar a la mesa.
pairs.english: They accidentally dropped the tray just before reaching the table.

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué raro que no haya llamado todavía si suele llegar puntual!
pairs.english: How strange that she hasn't called yet when she usually arrives on time!

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué pena que se haya quemado el bizcocho justo antes de merendar!
pairs.english: What a shame that the sponge cake burned right before afternoon tea!

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué suerte que no te hayas atragantado al comer tan rápido!
pairs.english: How lucky that you didn't choke while eating so fast!

pairs.spanish: ¡Menos mal que preparaste un picoteo para calmar el antojo!
pairs.english: Thank goodness you prepared some snacks to satisfy the craving!

pairs.spanish: Carlos suele tomarse un café cargado antes de salir hacia la oficina.
pairs.english: Carlos usually has a strong coffee before heading to the office.

pairs.spanish: Antes seguía todas las recetas al pie de la letra, pero dejó de hacerlo al aprender a improvisar.
pairs.english: Before, she used to follow every recipe to the letter, but she stopped doing it when she learned to improvise.

pairs.spanish: Solía leerse las noticias de corrido mientras desayunaba.
pairs.english: He used to read the news straight through while having breakfast.

pairs.spanish: No deja de sorprenderme cómo siempre encuentra el condimento justo en un apuro.
pairs.english: It never ceases to surprise me how she always finds the right seasoning in a tight spot.

pairs.spanish: Estuvimos a punto de cancelar la cena, pero Carlos nos sacó de un apuro por los pelos.
pairs.english: We were on the verge of cancelling dinner, but Carlos got us out of a jam by the skin of our teeth.

pairs.spanish: Cuando todo parecía salir mal, volvió a probar el guiso y encontró la falla al instante.
pairs.english: When everything seemed to be going wrong, she tasted the stew again and found the flaw instantly.

pairs.spanish: ¡No vuelvo a improvisar un postre cinco minutos antes de que lleguen los invitados!
pairs.english: I am never improvising a dessert five minutes before the guests arrive again!

pairs.spanish: Al final la cena salió redonda y logramos salvar la noche.
pairs.english: In the end dinner turned out brilliantly and we managed to save the evening.

pairs.spanish: Pues, después de la pausa, el entrevistador cambió de tema.
pairs.english: Well, after the break, the interviewer changed the subject.

pairs.spanish: Bueno, si todos están de acuerdo, empezamos la charla ahora.
pairs.english: Well then, if everyone agrees, let's start the talk now.

pairs.spanish: Oiga, ¿me permite aclarar ese punto antes de pasar a otra pregunta?
pairs.english: Excuse me, may I clarify that point before moving to another question?

pairs.spanish: No contestó ningún mensaje en toda la semana; vamos, que no quiere participar, ¿verdad?
pairs.english: He didn't answer a single message all week; in short, he doesn't want to take part, right?

pairs.spanish: A ver, sin rodeos: ¿puedes terminar la parte del informe antes del viernes?
pairs.english: Let's see, straight out: can you finish your part of the report before Friday?

pairs.spanish: No es que no quiera ayudarte, es que hoy tengo una reunión detrás de otra.
pairs.english: It's not that I don't want to help you, it's just that today I have one meeting after another.

pairs.spanish: Perdón por el inciso, pero creo que empezamos a salirnos del tema.
pairs.english: Sorry for the aside, but I think we're starting to get off the subject.

pairs.spanish: Volvamos al tema y vayamos al grano antes de la pausa.
pairs.english: Let's get back to the topic and get to the point before the break.

pairs.spanish: Puede que tengas razón en ese punto, pero dudo que sea la única causa.
pairs.english: You may be right on that point, but I doubt it is the only cause.

pairs.spanish: A lo mejor llega un poco tarde por el tráfico, así que esperemos cinco minutos.
pairs.english: Maybe he'll arrive a bit late because of traffic, so let's wait five minutes.

pairs.spanish: —¿Te parece difícil abrir un negocio hoy? —¡Desde luego! Aunque con esfuerzo se logra.
pairs.english: —Do you think it's hard to open a business today? —Of course! Although with effort it can be done.

pairs.spanish: —¿Te arrepientes de haber cambiado de trabajo? —¡Qué va! Para nada, fue la mejor decisión.
pairs.english: —Do you regret having changed jobs? —Not at all! Not in the least, it was the best decision.

pairs.spanish: La locutora dijo esta mañana que la invitada llegaría hoy aquí a la emisora.
pairs.english: The presenter said this morning that the guest would arrive here at the station today.

pairs.spanish: La semana pasada la invitada soltó una anécdota y prometió que volvería allí al día siguiente.
pairs.english: Last week the guest came out with an anecdote and promised she would go back there the next day.

pairs.spanish: El oyente escribió que había escuchado la entrevista el día anterior.
pairs.english: The listener wrote that he had heard the interview the day before.

pairs.spanish: Como seguíamos frente al micrófono, comentó que terminaríamos la charla hoy mismo.
pairs.english: Since we were still in front of the microphone, she remarked that we would finish the chat today.

pairs.spanish: A decir verdad, abrir la panadería fue más difícil de lo que imaginaba.
pairs.english: To tell the truth, opening the bakery was harder than I imagined.

pairs.spanish: Para ser sincera, los primeros meses casi no dormía por el ritmo del horno.
pairs.english: To be honest, the first few months I barely slept because of the pace of the oven.

pairs.spanish: Con franqueza, la clientela del barrio nos sostuvo desde el primer día.
pairs.english: Frankly, the neighbourhood clientele supported us from day one.

pairs.spanish: Dicho esto, volvería a elegir este trabajo sin dudarlo.
pairs.english: That said, I would choose this work again without hesitating.

pairs.spanish: Como no terminemos la entrega antes de las cinco, perderemos el contrato.
pairs.english: If we don't finish the delivery before five, we will lose the contract.

pairs.spanish: Como hayas dejado el informe sin revisar, tendremos que repetir todo.
pairs.english: If you've left the report unchecked, we'll have to redo everything.

pairs.spanish: Como no avisaste ayer, nadie estaba sobre aviso esta mañana.
pairs.english: Since you didn't let us know yesterday, nobody was forewarned this morning.

pairs.spanish: Tienes que llegar a tiempo; de lo contrario, no podremos contar contigo.
pairs.english: You have to arrive on time; otherwise, we won't be able to count on you.

pairs.spanish: Si dejas el envío a última hora, cualquier fallo te dejará sin margen.
pairs.english: If you leave the dispatch to the last minute, any failure will leave you with no leeway.

pairs.spanish: Si se perdiera el archivo principal, recuperaríamos el trabajo desde el respaldo.
pairs.english: If the main file were lost, we would recover the work from the backup.

pairs.spanish: Si hubieras guardado una copia ayer, hoy no tendrías que repetir el informe.
pairs.english: If you had saved a copy yesterday, today you wouldn't have to redo the report.

pairs.spanish: Voy a guardar dos copias del archivo por si acaso hay un corte de luz.
pairs.english: I'm going to save two copies of the file just in case there is a power cut.

pairs.spanish: No podemos posponer la entrega a menos que el cliente acepte una prórroga.
pairs.english: We cannot postpone the delivery unless the client accepts an extension.

pairs.spanish: Acepto adelantar el trabajo con tal de que me envíes el anexo hoy mismo.
pairs.english: I agree to bring the work forward as long as you send me the attachment today.

pairs.spanish: Cumpliremos el compromiso siempre que mantengamos un margen de dos horas.
pairs.english: We will fulfil the commitment provided that we keep a two-hour leeway.

pairs.spanish: En caso de que falte alguna condición en el anexo, avísame de inmediato.
pairs.english: In case any condition is missing from the attachment, let me know right away.

pairs.spanish: El informe debe enviarse hoy; de no ser así, el contrato prevé una penalización.
pairs.english: The report must be sent today; if not, the contract provides for a penalty.

pairs.spanish: De producirse un fallo técnico, tenemos tiempo de sobra para remediarlo.
pairs.english: Should a technical failure occur, we have plenty of time to put it right.

pairs.spanish: De haber detectado la urgencia antes, habríamos evitado el recargo.
pairs.english: Had we detected the emergency earlier, we would have avoided the surcharge.

pairs.spanish: Comprobando los datos antes del envío, evitaríamos cualquier problema.
pairs.english: By checking the data before dispatch, we would avoid any problem.

pairs.spanish: Deberíamos haber hecho la prueba del envío una hora antes.
pairs.english: We should have run the dispatch test an hour earlier.

pairs.spanish: Tendrías que haberme advertido del tropiezo en cuanto falló el archivo.
pairs.english: You should have warned me about the slip-up as soon as the file failed.

pairs.spanish: Me arrepiento de haber pospuesto la revisión hasta la tarde.
pairs.english: I regret having postponed the review until the afternoon.

pairs.spanish: Si no hubiéramos guardado el respaldo, todo el trabajo habría sido en vano.
pairs.english: If we hadn't saved the backup, all the work would have been in vain.

pairs.spanish: Será un poco costoso, pero vale la pena por la calidad.
pairs.english: It may well be a bit costly, but it is worth it for the quality.

pairs.spanish: Tendría razón en su crítica, pero el tono fue exagerado.
pairs.english: He may well have been right in his criticism, but the tone was over the top.

pairs.spanish: Habrá tenido algún defecto al principio, pero el resultado final compensa.
pairs.english: It may well have had some flaw at the start, but the final result makes up for it.

pairs.spanish: Será un lujo para algunos, pero no es para tanto si se usa todos los días.
pairs.english: It may well be a luxury for some, but it is no big deal if it is used every day.

pairs.spanish: Pese al sobrecosto inicial, el servicio resultó rentable al segundo año.
pairs.english: Despite the initial cost overrun, the service turned out to be cost-effective in the second year.

pairs.spanish: A pesar de que muchos hablaron de despilfarro, los datos muestran lo contrario.
pairs.english: Although many spoke of a waste of money, the data show the opposite.

pairs.spanish: Aun cuando parezca un capricho caro, el proyecto responde a una necesidad real.
pairs.english: Even if it seems an expensive whim, the project answers a real need.

pairs.spanish: El desembolso exige un sacrificio; así y todo, conviene aprobarlo.
pairs.english: The outlay requires a sacrifice; even so, it is advisable to approve it.

pairs.spanish: Con lo cansada que estaba Meg, terminó todo el trabajo antes de cenar.
pairs.english: Considering how tired Meg was, she finished all the work before dinner.

pairs.spanish: Con lo que costó la reforma, el resultado deja mucho que desear.
pairs.english: Considering how much the renovation cost, the result leaves a lot to be desired.

pairs.spanish: Para lo poco que cobra, atiende cada reclamo con mucha paciencia.
pairs.english: For how little he earns, he handles every complaint with great patience.

pairs.spanish: Para lo que ofrece el abono mensual, la tarifa me parece desproporcionada.
pairs.english: For what the monthly pass offers, the fare seems disproportionate to me.

pairs.spanish: Resulta absurdo que nadie haya revisado las cifras antes de firmar.
pairs.english: It is absurd that nobody checked the figures before signing.

pairs.spanish: Es lamentable que pasen por alto el mérito de los técnicos locales.
pairs.english: It is regrettable that they overlook the credit of the local technicians.

pairs.spanish: Era indignante que el servicio dejara tanto que desear después de la reforma.
pairs.english: It was outrageous that the service left so much to be desired after the renovation.

pairs.spanish: Es discutible que esa medida sea la más acertada para el barrio.
pairs.english: It is debatable whether that measure is the wisest one for the neighbourhood.

pairs.spanish: El tranvía redujo el ruido en el centro. Ahora bien, el trazado dejó fuera dos barrios.
pairs.english: The tram reduced noise in the centre. That said, the route left out two neighbourhoods.

pairs.spanish: Las obras fueron lentas; no obstante, hoy casi nadie discute su utilidad.
pairs.english: The works were slow; nevertheless, today almost nobody disputes its usefulness.

pairs.spanish: El autobús tarda cuarenta minutos; el tranvía, en cambio, completa el recorrido en quince.
pairs.english: The bus takes forty minutes; the tram, on the other hand, completes the route in fifteen.

pairs.spanish: A fin de cuentas, conviene sopesar las molestias frente a las ventajas diarias.
pairs.english: At the end of the day, it is advisable to weigh up the inconveniences against the daily advantages.

pairs.spanish: Pide el menú más caro cada viernes: ¡ni que fuera millonario!
pairs.english: He orders the most expensive menu every Friday: as if he were a millionaire!

pairs.spanish: Te quedaste pálido por un correo: ¡ni que hubieras visto un fantasma!
pairs.english: You went pale over an email: as if you had seen a ghost!

pairs.spanish: Todo el mundo aplaudió porque llegó a la hora: ¡ni que hubiera hecho un milagro!
pairs.english: Everyone applauded because he arrived on time: as if he had performed a miracle!

pairs.spanish: No me tomes el pelo: ¡ni que ese chiste fuera tan bueno!
pairs.english: Don't pull my leg: as if that joke were that good!

pairs.spanish: Llegaste un poquito tarde a la cena: empezamos hace hora y media.
pairs.english: You arrived a tiny bit late to dinner: we started an hour and a half ago.

pairs.spanish: Conseguimos entradas para la primera fila: no está mal, ¿verdad?
pairs.english: We got front-row tickets: not bad at all, right?

pairs.spanish: Necesitaron nada menos que cuatro reuniones para cambiar el título del archivo.
pairs.english: They needed no less than four meetings to change the file title.

pairs.spanish: Se fue la luz en la oficina y, para colmo, nadie había guardado el borrador.
pairs.english: The power went out in the office and, to top it all off, nobody had saved the draft.

pairs.spanish: ¡Qué maravilla que hayan elegido la hora más difícil para todos!
pairs.english: How wonderful that they chose the hardest time for everyone!

pairs.spanish: Me encanta que nadie lea las instrucciones antes de preguntar.
pairs.english: I just love how nobody reads the instructions before asking.

pairs.spanish: ¿Nos avisan del cambio diez minutos antes del examen? ¡A buena hora!
pairs.english: They tell us about the change ten minutes before the exam? A fine time!

pairs.spanish: Dice que fue un error sin importancia: ¡qué gracia tiene ese disparate!
pairs.english: He says it was an unimportant mistake: how funny that absurdity is!

pairs.spanish: Se echó a reír como si hubiera contado el mejor chiste del año.
pairs.english: He burst out laughing as if he had told the best joke of the year.

pairs.spanish: Cuando le preguntaron por el error, se hizo el tonto como si no supiera de qué hablaban.
pairs.english: When they asked him about the mistake, he played dumb as if he did not know what they were talking about.

pairs.spanish: Fingió una sonrisa amable y siguió hablando en serio como si nada.
pairs.english: She feigned a polite smile and kept talking seriously as if nothing had happened.

pairs.spanish: Me mira con risa contenida, como si estuviera a punto de soltar otra broma.
pairs.english: He looks at me with suppressed laughter, as if he were about to drop another joke.

pairs.spanish: ¿Para qué enviar un correo de tres líneas cuando podemos convocar un comité entero?
pairs.english: Why send a three-line email when we can convene an entire committee?

pairs.spanish: La columna usa un tono mordaz para ridiculizar el despropósito de las reuniones infinitas.
pairs.english: The column uses a biting tone to ridicule the absurdity of endless meetings.

pairs.spanish: En esa oficina, la agenda compartida es un laberinto del que nadie sale antes de las seis.
pairs.english: In that office, the shared schedule is a labyrinth from which nobody escapes before six.

pairs.spanish: La sátira funciona mejor cuando el narrador finge aprobar lo que en realidad critica.
pairs.english: Satire works best when the narrator pretends to approve of what he is actually criticising.

pairs.spanish: ¿Nos tomamos un cafecito antes de volver a la oficina?
pairs.english: Shall we have a friendly coffee before heading back to the office?

pairs.spanish: Salió tan enojado que dio un portazo al cerrar la puerta.
pairs.english: He left so angry that he slammed the door on his way out.

pairs.spanish: Al principio nos dieron un cuartucho sin ventana, pero pedimos cambio.
pairs.english: At first they gave us a dingy little room without a window, so we asked to switch.

pairs.spanish: En el último minuto marcó un golazo que puso de pie a todo el estadio.
pairs.english: In the last minute he scored a cracker of a goal that brought the whole stadium to its feet.

pairs.spanish: Disculpe, quería pedirle un favorcito con este documento.
pairs.english: Excuse me, I wanted to ask you a small favour with this document.
